grammarLesson-foundations-attached-promp.source: Which form ends with the pronoun for ‘him’?
grammarLesson-foundations-attached-promp.text: Wace siga ce take ƙarewa da wakilin suna na «shi»?

grammarLesson-foundations-attached-rule.source: Pronouns can attach directly to a preposition, a noun or a verb. Their role depends on the word they attach to.
grammarLesson-foundations-attached-rule.text: Ana iya liƙa wakilin suna kai tsaye ga harafin jarri, suna ko aikatau. Matsayinsa ya danganta da kalmar da aka liƙa shi gare ta.

grammarLesson-foundations-attached-word-.text: Zuwa gare ku / dominku, ga mutane fiye da ɗaya

grammarLesson-foundations-definite-promp.source: Which word refers to a specific book?
grammarLesson-foundations-definite-promp.text: Wace kalma ce take nuni ga takamaiman littafi?

grammarLesson-foundations-definite-rule.source: The prefix al- ({arabic}) makes a noun definite. In English it often corresponds to ‘the’.
grammarLesson-foundations-definite-rule.text: Idan aka sa al- ({arabic}) a farkon suna, sunan ya zama takamaimai. Yana yawan daidaita da «the» a Turanci.

grammarLesson-foundations-demonstratives.source: Demonstratives point to someone or something. Arabic has different forms for distance, gender and number.
grammarLesson-foundations-demonstratives.text: Kalmomin nuni suna nuna wani mutum ko abu. A Larabci siffofinsu sun bambanta bisa nisa, jinsi da adadi.

grammarLesson-foundations-detached-promp.text: Wane wakilin suna ne yake nufin «shi»?

grammarLesson-foundations-detached-rule.source: Detached pronouns can stand on their own. In a sentence they can point to the person you are speaking about.
grammarLesson-foundations-detached-rule.text: Wakilin suna mai zaman kansa yana iya tsayawa shi kaɗai. A jumla yana iya nuna mutumin da kake magana a kansa.

grammarLesson-foundations-gender-prompt.text: Wane suna ne yake da tāʾ marbūṭah?

grammarLesson-foundations-gender-rule.source: Many feminine nouns end in tāʾ marbūṭah ({arabic}). Some feminine nouns have no visible feminine ending.
grammarLesson-foundations-gender-rule.text: Sunayen jinsi na mace da yawa suna ƙarewa da tāʾ marbūṭah ({arabic}). Wasunsu ba su da alamar jinsi na mace a ƙarshe.

grammarLesson-foundations-idafah-prompt.text: Wace magana ce take haɗa sunaye biyu?

grammarLesson-foundations-idafah-rule.source: An iḍāfah links two nouns. The second noun is genitive, and the first noun takes neither al- nor tanwīn.
grammarLesson-foundations-idafah-rule.text: Iḍāfah tana haɗa sunaye biyu. Suna na biyu yana matsayin jarri. Suna na farko ba ya ɗaukar al- ko tanwini.

grammarLesson-foundations-number-prompt.text: Wace siga ce take nufin lambuna biyu?

grammarLesson-foundations-number-rule.source: Arabic has a distinct form for two. A plural can take an ending or change the shape of the word.
grammarLesson-foundations-number-rule.text: Larabci yana da siga ta musamman don abu biyu. Ana iya nuna jam’i da ƙari a ƙarshen kalma ko ta sauya siffar kalmar.

grammarLesson-foundations-prepositions-p.text: Wane harafin jarri ne ya fara wannan misalin?

grammarLesson-foundations-prepositions-r.source: Prepositions show relationships such as ‘from’, ‘in’ and ‘to’. An ordinary noun following a preposition is genitive.
grammarLesson-foundations-prepositions-r.text: Haruffan jarri suna nuna alaƙa kamar «daga», «a ciki» da «zuwa». Suna na yau da kullum da ya biyo bayan harafin jarri yana matsayin jarri.

grammarLesson-foundations-relatives-prom.source: Which form is used for ‘those who’ here?
grammarLesson-foundations-relatives-prom.text: Wace siga ake amfani da ita don «waɗanda» a nan?

grammarLesson-foundations-relatives-rule.source: A relative pronoun introduces more information about someone or something. Common English equivalents are ‘who’, ‘which’ and ‘that’.
grammarLesson-foundations-relatives-rule.text: Wakilin suna mai haɗi yana gabatar da ƙarin bayani game da mutum ko abu. A Turanci ana yawan amfani da «who», «which» da «that» don wannan aiki.

grammarLesson-foundations-word-types-pro.source: What kind of word is qul, ‘say’?
grammarLesson-foundations-word-types-pro.text: Wane nau’in kalma ne qul, wato «ka ce»?

grammarLesson-foundations-word-types-rul.source: Arabic grammar groups words into ism, fiʿl and ḥarf. Pronouns and adjectives also belong to the ism group.
grammarLesson-foundations-word-types-rul.text: Nahawun Larabci yana raba kalmomi zuwa ism, fiʿl da ḥarf. Wakilan suna da siffofi suna cikin rukunin ism.

grammarLesson-foundations-word-types-tit.text: Sunaye, aikatau da ƙananan kalmomin nahawu

grammarLesson-foundations-word-types-wor.text: Suna da kalmomin da suke da alaƙa da shi

grammarLesson-roots-command-example-1-no.source: Ihdinā asks for guidance. The nā means ‘us’.
grammarLesson-roots-command-example-1-no.text: Ihdinā tana neman shiriya. Ƙarin nā yana nufin «mu».

grammarLesson-roots-command-example-2-no.source: After fa-, sabbiḥ is the imperative ‘glorify’.
grammarLesson-roots-command-example-2-no.text: Bayan fa-, sabbiḥ umarni ne mai ma’anar «tsarkake».

grammarLesson-roots-command-prompt.source: Which form directly tells someone to write?
grammarLesson-roots-command-prompt.text: Wace siga ce take gaya wa mutum kai tsaye ya rubuta?

grammarLesson-roots-command-rule.source: The imperative directly addresses someone. Its use can be a command or a request. Compare uktub, ‘write’, with yaktubu, ‘he writes’.
grammarLesson-roots-command-rule.text: Sigar umarni tana magana da mutum kai tsaye. Ana iya amfani da ita don umarni ko buƙata. Kwatanta uktub, «ka rubuta», da yaktubu, «yana rubutawa».

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-1-.source: Faʿala means ‘he did’. The three root letters supply the base pattern.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-1-.text: Faʿala tana nufin «ya aikata». Haruffan tushe uku suna bayar da sigar asali.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-2-.source: ʿAllama means ‘he taught’, sharing the root of ʿalima, ‘he knew’. Notice the doubled lām.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-2-.text: ʿAllama tana nufin «ya koyar», tushenta ɗaya ne da ʿalima, «ya sani». Lura da lām mai shadda.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-3-.source: Qātilū is a plural command to fight. The long ā follows the first root letter.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-3-.text: Qātilū umarnin yin faɗa ne ga mutane fiye da ɗaya. Dogon ā yana bin harafin farko na tushe.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-4-.source: Aʿṭaynāka means ‘we granted you’. The initial hamzah is part of Form IV.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-4-.text: Aʿṭaynāka tana nufin «Mun ba ka». Hamzar farko tana cikin siga ta IV.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-5-.source: Yadhdhakkaru refers to someone taking a reminder to heart. The prefix of Form V is assimilated here.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-example-5-.text: Yadhdhakkaru tana bayyana wanda ya ɗauki tunatarwa da muhimmanci. Ƙarin farkon siga ta V ya narke cikin harafin da ke biye a nan.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-prompt.source: Which form does ʿallama use in {reference}?
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-prompt.text: Wace siga ce ʿallama take bi a {reference}?

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-rule.source: Form I is the basic pattern, with its own vowel variations. Forms II–V add sounds, such as a doubled middle consonant, a long vowel, or a prefix. These changes suggest a sense to look for. Check the word in its āyah.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-rule.text: Siga ta I ita ce sigar asali, kuma wasalanta suna iya bambanta. Sigogi na II–V suna ƙara sauti, kamar shadda ga harafin tsakiya, dogon wasali, ko ƙari a farko. Waɗannan canje-canje suna ba da alamar ma’anar da za a nema. Duba kalmar a cikin ayarta.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-word-2-mea.source: Often makes an action intensive or causes it
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-word-2-mea.text: Sau da yawa tana ƙarfafa aiki ko sa a yi shi

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-word-3-mea.source: Often directs the action toward another party
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-word-3-mea.text: Sau da yawa tana nuna aikin da aka yi wa wani

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-word-4-mea.source: Often causes a change or reaches an object
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-word-4-mea.text: Sau da yawa tana jawo canji ko sa aikin ya shafi wani abu

grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-word-5-mea.source: Often shows the subject taking on or undergoing the action
grammarLesson-roots-forms-1-5-word-5-mea.text: Sau da yawa tana nuna mai aikatawa yana ɗaukar aikin ko aikin yana shafarsa

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-1.source: Taẓāharūna describes people supporting one another.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-1.text: Taẓāharūna tana bayyana mutane suna taimakon juna.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-2.source: Yanqalib describes someone turning back. Notice the n before the first root letter.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-2.text: Yanqalib tana bayyana wanda ya juya baya. Lura da n kafin harafin farko na tushe.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-3.source: Taʿtadhirū concerns making excuses. Look for the t after the first root letter.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-3.text: Taʿtadhirū tana da alaƙa da bayar da uzuri. Nemo t bayan harafin farko na tushe.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-4.source: Taswaddu describes darkening. Notice the doubled final consonant.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-4.text: Taswaddu tana bayyana yin duhu. Lura da shadda a harafin ƙarshe.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-5.source: Wa-staghfirhu asks the listener to seek His forgiveness. The s and t precede the root.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-example-5.text: Wa-staghfirhu tana roƙon mai sauraro ya nemi gafararSa. Haruffan s da t suna kafin tushe.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-prompt.source: Which form gives the sense ‘seek’ in wa-staghfirhu?
grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-prompt.text: Wace siga ce take ba da ma’anar «nema» a wa-staghfirhu?

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-rule.source: Look for added sounds and positions. Form VI often shows mutual action, VII a change the subject undergoes, VIII an action involving the subject, IX a colour or state, and X can express seeking.
grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-rule.text: Nemi ƙarin sautuka da matsayinsu. Siga ta VI tana yawan nuna aikin da ake yi wa juna, ta VII canjin da ya shafi mai aikatawa, ta VIII aikin da ya haɗa da mai aikatawa, ta IX launi ko hali, ta X kuma tana iya nuna nema.

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-word-1-me.text: Sau da yawa aiki ga juna

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-word-2-me.text: Sau da yawa canjin da ya shafi mai aikatawa

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-word-3-me.text: Tana iya nuna aikin da aka yi wa kai ko juna

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-word-4-me.source: Often a colour or bodily state
grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-word-4-me.text: Sau da yawa launi ko yanayin jiki

grammarLesson-roots-forms-6-10-word-5-me.text: Sau da yawa nema ko roƙo

grammarLesson-roots-masdar-example-1-not.source: Takbīran names the action urged by the command wa-kabbirhu.
grammarLesson-roots-masdar-example-1-not.text: Takbīran tana ambaton aikin da umarnin wa-kabbirhu ya ƙarfafa.

grammarLesson-roots-masdar-example-2-not.source: Taklīman is a verbal noun from the same root as kallama, ‘spoke’.
grammarLesson-roots-masdar-example-2-not.text: Taklīman suna ne na aiki daga tushe ɗaya da kallama, «ya yi magana».

grammarLesson-roots-masdar-prompt.source: Which word names the action of magnifying?
grammarLesson-roots-masdar-prompt.text: Wace kalma ce take ambaton aikin girmamawa?

grammarLesson-roots-masdar-rule.source: A maṣdar names the action itself. It behaves like a noun. Form II often uses the tafʿīl pattern for its verbal noun.
grammarLesson-roots-masdar-rule.text: Maṣdar yana ba da sunan aikin kansa. Yana aiki kamar suna. Siga ta II tana yawan amfani da sigar tafʿīl wajen samar da sunan aikinta.

grammarLesson-roots-negation-example-1-n.source: Lā negates the worship in aʿbudu.
grammarLesson-roots-negation-example-1-n.text: Lā tana kore yin bauta a cikin aʿbudu.

grammarLesson-roots-negation-example-2-n.source: Mā goes with the perfect aghnā, ‘availed’.
grammarLesson-roots-negation-example-2-n.text: Mā tana tare da aikatau na abin da ya wuce aghnā, «ya amfana».

grammarLesson-roots-negation-example-3-n.source: Lam negates yalid. The imperfect ends in sukūn here.
grammarLesson-roots-negation-example-3-n.text: Lam tana kore abin da yalid yake nufi. Aikataun da ba a nuna kammalarsa ba yana ƙarewa da sukuni a nan.

grammarLesson-roots-negation-example-4-n.source: Lan denies attaining righteousness. The plural verb tanālū shows the subjunctive by dropping the final n of tanālūna.
grammarLesson-roots-negation-example-4-n.text: Lan tana kore samun kyautatawa. Aikataun jam’i tanālū yana nuna nasbi ta hanyar cire n na ƙarshen tanālūna.

grammarLesson-roots-negation-prompt.source: Which particle introduces the future negation in {reference}?
grammarLesson-roots-negation-prompt.text: Wace ƙaramar kalma ce take gabatar da korewar abin da zai faru a {reference}?

grammarLesson-roots-negation-rule.source: Look at the verb after a negative particle. Here lā negates a present action and mā negates a past action. Lam uses an imperfect verb to deny a past action. Lan puts an imperfect verb into the subjunctive to deny a future outcome.
grammarLesson-roots-negation-rule.text: Duba aikataun da ya biyo bayan kalmar korewa. A nan lā tana kore aikin yanzu, mā tana kore aikin da ya wuce. Lam tana amfani da aikataun da ba a nuna kammalarsa ba don kore aikin da ya wuce. Lan tana sa irin wannan aikatau ya shiga nasbi don kore abin da zai faru a gaba.

grammarLesson-roots-negation-title.text: Kore magana · lā, mā, lam, lan

grammarLesson-roots-negation-word-1-mean.text: Ba ya yi a wannan misalin

grammarLesson-roots-negation-word-2-mean.text: Bai yi ba a wannan misalin

grammarLesson-roots-negation-word-3-mean.text: Bai yi ba, tare da aikatau a jazmi

grammarLesson-roots-negation-word-4-mean.text: Ba zai yi ba, tare da aikatau a nasbi

grammarLesson-roots-participles-example-.source: Shāniʾaka describes the person who hates you.
grammarLesson-roots-participles-example-.text: Shāniʾaka tana bayyana mutumin da yake ƙin ka.
Sunan abin da aka yi wa aiki

grammarLesson-roots-participles-example-.source: Maʾkūl describes something that has been eaten.
grammarLesson-roots-participles-example-.text: Maʾkūl tana bayyana abin da aka ci.

grammarLesson-roots-participles-prompt.source: Which word describes something that has been written?
grammarLesson-roots-participles-prompt.text: Wace kalma ce take bayyana abin da aka rubuta?

grammarLesson-roots-participles-rule.source: An active participle can describe someone who does an action. A passive participle can describe what the action affects. In basic three-letter verbs, fāʿil and mafʿūl are common shapes.
grammarLesson-roots-participles-rule.text: Sunan mai aikatawa yana iya bayyana wanda ya yi aiki. Sunan abin da aka yi wa aiki yana iya bayyana abin da aikin ya shafa. A aikatau mai haruffan tushe uku, fāʿil da mafʿūl sigogi ne da ake yawan samu.

grammarLesson-roots-participles-title.text: Sunaye na mai aikatawa da abin da aka yi wa aiki

grammarLesson-roots-past-example-1-note.source: Faʿala has the same vowel shape as kataba.
grammarLesson-roots-past-example-1-note.text: Faʿala tana da tsarin wasalai iri ɗaya da kataba.

grammarLesson-roots-past-example-2-note.source: The nā in aʿṭaynāka is the subject, ‘we’. The ka is the person addressed.
grammarLesson-roots-past-example-2-note.text: Ƙarin nā a aʿṭaynāka shi ne mai aikatawa, wato «mu». Ƙarin ka yana nuna wanda ake magana da shi.

grammarLesson-roots-past-prompt.text: Wane aikatau ne yake nufin «mun rubuta»?

grammarLesson-roots-past-rule.source: The perfect verb generally presents an action as complete. Its endings can show who did it. In the k-t-b family, kataba means ‘he wrote’ and katabnā means ‘we wrote’.
grammarLesson-roots-past-rule.text: Aikataun abin da ya wuce yakan nuna aikin da aka kammala. Ƙarin da ke ƙarshensa yana iya bayyana wanda ya yi aikin. A dangin k-t-b, kataba tana nufin «ya rubuta», katabnā kuma «mun rubuta».

grammarLesson-roots-present-example-1-no.source: Naʿbudu begins with na-, the prefix for ‘we’.
grammarLesson-roots-present-example-1-no.text: Naʿbudu tana farawa da na-, ƙarin farko na «mu».

grammarLesson-roots-present-example-2-no.source: Nastaʿīnu also begins with na-. The rest of the verb uses a different pattern.
grammarLesson-roots-present-example-2-no.text: Nastaʿīnu ita ma tana farawa da na-. Sauran ɓangaren aikataun yana bi wata siga dabam.

grammarLesson-roots-present-prompt.source: Which verb begins with the same ‘we’ prefix as naʿbudu?
grammarLesson-roots-present-prompt.text: Wane aikatau ne yake farawa da ƙarin farkon «mu» irin na naʿbudu?

grammarLesson-roots-present-rule.source: The imperfect verb takes a prefix that helps identify who acts. It can describe what someone does, is doing, or will do, depending on context.
grammarLesson-roots-present-rule.text: Aikataun da ba a nuna kammalarsa ba yana ɗaukar ƙari a farko wanda ke nuna mai aikin. Yana iya bayyana abin da mutum yakan yi, yake yi yanzu ko zai yi, bisa mahallin magana.

grammarLesson-roots-present-title.text: Aikataun abin da ke faruwa yanzu

grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-exam.source: Allāhu is the topic here. Notice the final u vowel.
grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-exam.text: Allāhu shi ne batun jimlar a nan. Lura da wasalin u a ƙarshe.

grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-exam.source: Al-kawthara is what was given. Notice the final a vowel.
grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-exam.text: Al-kawthara tana nuna abin da aka bayar. Lura da wasalin a a ƙarshe.

grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-exam.source: The preposition bi- makes rabbi genitive. Notice the final i vowel.
grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-exam.text: Harafin jarri bi- yana sa rabbi ya shiga jarri. Lura da wasalin i a ƙarshe.

grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-prom.source: Which case does al-kawthara have in {reference}?
grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-prom.text: Wane matsayin nahawu ne al-kawthara take da shi a {reference}?

grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-rule.source: Case marks show the role of a noun. In many singular nouns, the usual vowel for rafʿ is ḍammah, for naṣb it is fatḥah, and for jarr it is kasrah. Read the ending as you connect the words.
grammarLesson-sentence-case-endings-rule.text: Alamomin ƙarshen suna suna nuna matsayinsa a jimla. A yawancin sunaye na abu ɗaya, wasalin raf’i shi ne damma, na nasbi fat’ha, na jarri kuma kasra. Furta alamar ƙarshen yayin da kake haɗa kalmomin.

grammarLesson-sentence-condition-result-.source: The condition describes doing even an atom’s weight of good.
grammarLesson-sentence-condition-result-.text: Sharaɗin yana bayyana aikata alheri ko da nauyin ƙwayar zarra ne.

grammarLesson-sentence-condition-result-.source: The person will see that good. The attached hu points back to it.
grammarLesson-sentence-condition-result-.text: Mutumin zai ga wannan alherin. Ƙarin hu yana komawa ga alherin.

grammarLesson-sentence-condition-result-.source: Which word introduces the condition in {reference}?
grammarLesson-sentence-condition-result-.text: Wace kalma ce take gabatar da sharaɗin a {reference}?

grammarLesson-sentence-condition-result-.source: A conditional sentence connects a condition and its result. In this āyah, man introduces the condition. The last word gives the result.
grammarLesson-sentence-condition-result-.text: Jimlar sharaɗi tana haɗa sharaɗi da sakamakonsa. A wannan ayar, man tana fara sharaɗin. Kalmar ƙarshe tana ba da sakamakon.

grammarLesson-sentence-read-tafsir-comme.source: Ibn Kathīr explains al-Kawthar as the great abundance of good that Allah granted the Prophet. He includes the river in Paradise among those gifts.
grammarLesson-sentence-read-tafsir-comme.text: Ibn Kathir ya bayyana Al-Kausar a matsayin yalwataccen alherin da Allah Ya ba Annabi. Ya haɗa kogin Aljanna cikin waɗannan kyaututtukan.

grammarLesson-sentence-read-tafsir-examp.text: Kyautar da aka ambata a ayar

grammarLesson-sentence-read-tafsir-examp.source: Aʿṭaynāka names the act of giving and who received it. Al-kawthara names the gift.
grammarLesson-sentence-read-tafsir-examp.text: Aʿṭaynāka tana nuna aikin bayarwa da wanda ya karɓa. Al-kawthara tana nuna kyautar.

grammarLesson-sentence-read-tafsir-promp.source: Which word names the gift in Ibn Kathīr’s explanation?
grammarLesson-sentence-read-tafsir-promp.text: Wace kalma ce take ambaton kyautar a bayanin Ibn Kathir?

grammarLesson-sentence-read-tafsir-rule.source: Find what was given in {reference}. Then read how Ibn Kathīr explains that gift.
grammarLesson-sentence-read-tafsir-rule.text: Nemo abin da aka bayar a {reference}. Sannan ka karanta yadda Ibn Kathir ya bayyana kyautar.

grammarLesson-sentence-sentence-types-ex.source: Allāhu is the topic. Al-ṣamadu tells us about Him.
grammarLesson-sentence-sentence-types-ex.text: Allāhu shi ne batun. Al-ṣamadu tana ba da bayani game da Shi.

grammarLesson-sentence-sentence-types-ex.source: Aʿṭaynāka contains the verb ‘gave’ and the attached subject nā, ‘we’.
grammarLesson-sentence-sentence-types-ex.text: Aʿṭaynāka ta ƙunshi aikataun «ba da» da mai aikin da aka liƙa, nā, wato «mu».

grammarLesson-sentence-sentence-types-pr.source: What role does al-ṣamadu have in {reference}?
grammarLesson-sentence-sentence-types-pr.text: Wane matsayi ne al-ṣamadu take da shi a {reference}?

grammarLesson-sentence-sentence-types-ru.source: A basic nominal sentence pairs a topic with a predicate. A verbal clause pairs a verb with the subject that does the action. The subject can be part of the verb itself.
grammarLesson-sentence-sentence-types-ru.text: Jimla ta suna mai sauƙi tana haɗa batu da bayaninsa. Ɓangaren jimla na aikatau yana haɗa aikatau da wanda ya yi aikin. Mai aikatawa yana iya zama ɓangare na aikataun kansa.

guideEidDetail.source: Eid prayer has two rakʿāt and includes extra takbīrs. Scholars differ on how many and when to say them. Follow your imam.
guideEidDetail.text: Sallar Idi tana da raka’a biyu da ƙarin kabbarori. Malamai sun bambanta kan adadinsu da lokacin da ake yin su. Bi limaminka.

guideHanafiSahwDetail.source: When sajdah sahw is due, the Hanafi method is to give one salām to the right after the final tashahhud. Make two prostrations, then repeat the tashahhud, ṣalawāt and duʿāʾ before closing with salām. Scholars differ.
guideHanafiSahwDetail.text: Idan ana buƙatar sujudus sahwi, a tsarin Hanafiyya ana yin sallama ɗaya zuwa dama bayan tashahhudin ƙarshe. A yi sujada biyu, a sake tashahhudi da salati da addu’a, sannan a rufe da sallama. Malamai sun bambanta.

guideJanazahDetail.source: The funeral prayer is prayed standing. This narration records four takbīrs. Follow your imam and make duʿāʾ for the deceased.
guideJanazahDetail.text: Ana yin sallar janaza a tsaye. Wannan ruwayar ta ambaci kabbarori huɗu. Bi limaminka ka yi wa mamacin addu’a.

guideJumuahIntro.source: The Friday prayer has two Fard rakʿāt after the khutbah. Follow your imam in congregation.
guideJumuahIntro.text: Sallar Juma’a tana da raka’o’in farilla guda biyu bayan huɗuba. Bi limaminka a jam’i.

guideJumuahRecitation.source: Follow the imam during the recitation.

guideLostCount.text: Ka manta adadin raka’o’i a tsakiyar salla?

guideLostCountHelp.source: Unsure if it was 3 or 4? Sahih Muslim describes building on what you’re sure of and making two prostrations before salām. Scholars differ on how to apply this guidance.
guideLostCountHelp.text: Ba ka tabbatar raka’a 3 ce ko 4 ba? Sahih Muslim ya bayyana a ci gaba daga adadin da aka tabbatar, a yi sujada biyu kafin sallama. Malamai sun bambanta kan yadda ake amfani da wannan bayanin.

guideLostDesktopHelp.source: Sahih Muslim describes building on the lower number when you are unsure, then making two prostrations before salām. Scholars differ on how to apply this.
guideLostDesktopHelp.text: Sahih Muslim ya bayyana a ɗauki ƙaramin adadi idan ana shakka, sannan a yi sujada biyu kafin sallama. Malamai sun bambanta kan yadda ake amfani da wannan.

guideOpeningPraise.text: Wani ɓangare na yabon buɗe salla (sana’i)

guideProstrateDetail.source: Make two prostrations with a short sitting between them.
guideProstrateDetail.text: Yi sujada biyu da ɗan zama a tsakaninsu.

guideWitrDetail.source: The Hanafi outline includes three rakʿāt of Witr after Isha. This narration records a supplication for Witr. Scholars differ on the form and timing of qunūt.
guideWitrDetail.text: Tsarin Hanafiyya ya haɗa da raka’o’in wutiri uku bayan Lisha. Wannan ruwayar ta ambaci addu’ar wutiri. Malamai sun bambanta kan yadda ake ƙunuti da lokacinsa.

guideWitrDifference.source: Scholars differ on the status and form of Witr.
guideWitrDifference.text: Malamai sun bambanta kan matsayin wutiri da yadda ake yinsa.

hadithDesktopIntro.text: Ruwayoyin sahihi da hasan kawai, da kundi, lamba da darajar kowace ruwaya

hadithIntro.text: Shahararrun ruwayoyi masu darajar sahihi ko hasan kawai, tare da madogara da lambobin da za ka iya dubawa.

speakUnit-a2-airport-line-1.source: Excuse me, where can I drop off my bag?
speakUnit-a2-airport-line-1.text: A gafarta, ina zan miƙa jakata don a ɗora ta a jirgi?

speakUnit-a2-airport-line-2.source: At this counter. Do you have your boarding pass?
speakUnit-a2-airport-line-2.text: A wannan teburin. Kana da takardar shiga jirgi?

speakUnit-a2-airport-line-3.source: Yes, the pass is on my phone. Here it is.
speakUnit-a2-airport-line-3.text: E, tana a wayata. Ga ta.

speakUnit-a2-airport-line-4.source: Thank you. Put the bag on the scales.
speakUnit-a2-airport-line-4.text: Na gode. Ɗora jakar a kan ma’aunin nauyi.

speakUnit-a2-appointments-line-2.source: Of course. We have four o'clock tomorrow. Does that work?
speakUnit-a2-appointments-line-2.text: E. Muna da ƙarfe huɗu na gobe. Ya dace da kai?

speakUnit-a2-appointments-line-3.text: E, ƙarfe huɗu na gobe ya dace da ni.

speakUnit-a2-appointments-line-4.source: I've booked it for you. See you tomorrow.
speakUnit-a2-appointments-line-4.text: Na ajiye maka lokacin. Sai gobe.

speakUnit-a2-appointments-word-1.text: Ganawa ko lokacin da aka tsara

speakUnit-a2-bank-line-1.source: I'd like to send money to my family, please.
speakUnit-a2-bank-line-1.text: Ina son aika wa iyalina kuɗi, don Allah.

speakUnit-a2-bank-line-2.source: Do you have the recipient's account number?
speakUnit-a2-bank-line-2.text: Kana da lambar asusun wanda zai karɓa?

speakUnit-a2-bank-line-3.source: Yes, here's the account number. How much is the transfer fee?
speakUnit-a2-bank-line-3.text: E, ga lambar asusun. Nawa ne kuɗin aikawa?

speakUnit-a2-bank-line-4.source: You'll see the fee on the screen before you confirm.
speakUnit-a2-bank-line-4.text: Za ka ga kuɗin aikawa a allo kafin ka tabbatar.

speakUnit-a2-clinic-line-3.source: Since last night. The pain is worse today.
speakUnit-a2-clinic-line-3.text: Tun daren jiya. Ciwon ya ƙaru yau.

speakUnit-a2-documents-line-1.source: Excuse me, where can I renew my residence permit?
speakUnit-a2-documents-line-1.text: A gafarta, ina zan sabunta izinin zamana?

speakUnit-a2-documents-line-2.source: At this window. Have you booked an appointment?
speakUnit-a2-documents-line-2.text: A wannan tagar. Ka riga ka ajiye lokacin ganawa?

speakUnit-a2-documents-line-3.source: Not yet. Could you show me how to book?
speakUnit-a2-documents-line-3.text: Har yanzu ban ajiye ba. Za ka iya nuna mini yadda ake yi?

speakUnit-a2-documents-line-4.source: Of course, you can ask the person at reception.
speakUnit-a2-documents-line-4.text: E, kana iya tambayar ma’aikacin wurin tarba.

speakUnit-a2-family-line-1.source: Peace be upon you. I just moved in here.
speakUnit-a2-family-line-1.text: Assalamu alaikum. Yanzu-yanzu na ƙaura zuwa nan.

speakUnit-a2-family-line-2.source: And peace be upon you. Welcome. Is your family here with you?
speakUnit-a2-family-line-2.text: Wa alaikumus salam. Barka da zuwa. Iyalinka suna nan tare da kai?

speakUnit-a2-family-line-3.source: Yes, my family is with me. Nice to meet you.
speakUnit-a2-family-line-3.text: E, iyalina suna tare da ni. Na yi farin cikin haɗuwa da kai.

speakUnit-a2-family-line-4.source: The pleasure is mine. If you need anything, just let me know.
speakUnit-a2-family-line-4.text: Ni ma na yi farin ciki. Idan kana buƙatar wani abu, ka sanar da ni.

speakUnit-a2-feelings-line-1.source: I'm feeling a little down today.
speakUnit-a2-feelings-line-1.text: Ina ɗan jin baƙin ciki yau.

speakUnit-a2-feelings-line-2.source: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk?
speakUnit-a2-feelings-line-2.text: Na ji tausayinka. Kana son mu tattauna?

speakUnit-a2-feelings-line-3.source: Yes. If you have time, let's go for a short walk.
speakUnit-a2-feelings-line-3.text: E. Idan kana da lokaci, mu ɗan yi yawo.

speakUnit-a2-feelings-line-4.source: Of course, I'm here with you.

speakUnit-a2-feelings-word-2.text: Ina jin damuwa (mai magana namiji ne)

speakUnit-a2-invitations-line-1.source: Peace be upon you. I got your invitation, thank you.
speakUnit-a2-invitations-line-1.text: Assalamu alaikum. Na sami gayyatarka, na gode.

speakUnit-a2-invitations-line-2.source: And peace be upon you. Can you come on Friday?
speakUnit-a2-invitations-line-2.text: Wa alaikumus salam. Za ka iya zuwa ranar Juma’a?

speakUnit-a2-invitations-line-3.source: Yes, I'll come after Maghrib, God willing.
speakUnit-a2-invitations-line-3.text: E, zan zo bayan Magariba, in Allah Ya so.

speakUnit-a2-invitations-line-4.source: You're very welcome. See you Friday.

speakUnit-a2-jobs-line-1.source: Excuse me, is there an opening in customer service?
speakUnit-a2-jobs-line-1.text: A gafarta, akwai gurbin aiki a sashen kula da abokan ciniki?

speakUnit-a2-jobs-line-2.source: Yes. Do you have experience in this field?
speakUnit-a2-jobs-line-2.text: E. Ka taɓa yin irin wannan aikin?

speakUnit-a2-jobs-line-3.source: Yes, I worked in customer service for two years.
speakUnit-a2-jobs-line-3.text: E, na yi aiki a sashen kula da abokan ciniki shekara biyu.

speakUnit-a2-jobs-line-4.text: Madalla. Turo mana da takardar tarihin aikinka.

speakUnit-a2-office-line-1.source: Do we have a meeting today?

speakUnit-a2-office-line-2.source: Yes, at ten. Can you bring the report?
speakUnit-a2-office-line-2.text: E, da ƙarfe goma. Za ka iya kawo rahoton?

speakUnit-a2-office-line-3.source: Sure. I'll send it to you before the meeting.
speakUnit-a2-office-line-3.text: E. Zan turo maka shi kafin taron.

speakUnit-a2-phone-line-1.source: Hello, Sami speaking. Can you hear me clearly?
speakUnit-a2-phone-line-1.text: Sannu, Sami ne. Kana jin muryata sosai?

speakUnit-a2-phone-line-2.source: You're breaking up. Can you call me back in a bit?
speakUnit-a2-phone-line-2.text: Muryarka tana yankewa. Za ka iya sake kirana anjima kaɗan?

speakUnit-a2-phone-line-3.source: Sure, I'll call you back in ten minutes.
speakUnit-a2-phone-line-3.text: E, zan sake kiranka nan da minti goma.

speakUnit-a2-rent-line-1.source: Hello, is the apartment still available?
speakUnit-a2-rent-line-1.text: Sannu, har yanzu ana neman mai hayar gidan?

speakUnit-a2-rent-line-2.source: Yes, it has two rooms. Do you want to see it today?
speakUnit-a2-rent-line-2.text: E, yana da ɗakuna biyu. Kana son ganinsa yau?

speakUnit-a2-rent-line-3.source: Yes. After Asr works for me.
speakUnit-a2-rent-line-3.text: E. Bayan La’asar ya dace da ni.

speakUnit-a2-rent-line-4.source: Great, I'll see you at the entrance.
speakUnit-a2-rent-line-4.text: Madalla, za mu haɗu a mashigar.

speakUnit-a2-restaurant-line-2.source: Here you go. Would you like to order now?
speakUnit-a2-restaurant-line-2.text: Ga shi. Kana son zaɓar abinci yanzu?

speakUnit-a2-restaurant-line-3.source: Yes, I'd like rice and chicken with no chilli, please.
speakUnit-a2-restaurant-line-3.text: E, ina son shinkafa da naman kaza ba tare da barkono ba, don Allah.

speakUnit-a2-restaurant-line-4.source: Of course, I'll tell the kitchen.
speakUnit-a2-restaurant-line-4.text: To, zan faɗa wa masu girki.

speakUnit-a2-weather-line-1.source: It's cloudy today. Do you think it'll rain?
speakUnit-a2-weather-line-1.text: Akwai gajimare yau. Kana ganin za a yi ruwa?

speakUnit-a2-weather-line-2.source: Maybe after Maghrib. Are you going out?
speakUnit-a2-weather-line-2.text: Wataƙila bayan Magariba. Za ka fita?

speakUnit-a2-weather-line-3.source: Yes, but I'll take an umbrella.

speakUnit-b1-bargaining-line-1.source: Excuse me, how much are these scarves?
speakUnit-b1-bargaining-line-1.text: A gafarta, nawa ne farashin waɗannan mayafan?

speakUnit-b1-bargaining-line-2.source: Forty each. Do you want one or more?
speakUnit-b1-bargaining-line-2.text: Arba’in kowanne. Kana son ɗaya ko fiye?

speakUnit-b1-bargaining-line-3.source: I want two. If I take two, can you lower the price?
speakUnit-b1-bargaining-line-3.text: Ina son biyu. Idan na ɗauki biyu, za ka iya rage farashin?

speakUnit-b1-bargaining-line-4.source: I can give you both for seventy. Does that work for you?
speakUnit-b1-bargaining-line-4.text: Zan iya ba ka biyun a saba’in. Hakan ya dace da kai?

speakUnit-b1-bargaining-line-5.text: E, saba’in ya dace. Na gode.

speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-1.source: I'd like to return the kettle, please. I bought it yesterday and it doesn't work.
speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-1.text: Ina son mayar da tukunyar dafa ruwa, don Allah. Na saye ta jiya, kuma ba ta aiki.

speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-2.source: Could you explain the problem? Does the light come on?
speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-2.text: Za ka iya bayyana matsalar? Fitilar tana kunnawa?

speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-3.source: The light comes on, but the water never gets hot.
speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-3.text: Fitilar tana kunnawa, amma ruwan ba ya yin zafi.

speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-4.source: I understand. Would you like an exchange or a refund?
speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-4.text: Na fahimta. Kana son a sauya maka ita ko a mayar maka da kuɗinka?

speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-5.source: I'd prefer a refund if possible. Here's the receipt.
speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-5.text: Na fi son a mayar mini da kuɗina idan zai yiwu. Ga rasidin.

speakUnit-b1-complaints-line-6.source: Okay. Let me check the receipt.

speakUnit-b1-complaints-partner.text: Ma’aikacin karɓar kayan da aka mayar

speakUnit-b1-directions-line-1.source: If you're going to the library, I can explain the way.
speakUnit-b1-directions-line-1.text: Idan kana zuwa ɗakin karatu, zan iya nuna maka hanyar.

speakUnit-b1-directions-line-2.source: Yes, thank you. Where do I start?
speakUnit-b1-directions-line-2.text: E, na gode. Daga ina zan fara?

speakUnit-b1-directions-line-3.source: Go straight until you pass the pharmacy, then turn left.
speakUnit-b1-directions-line-3.text: Tafi kai tsaye har ka wuce kantin magani, sannan ka juya hagu.

speakUnit-b1-directions-line-4.source: After I turn left, which side is the library on?
speakUnit-b1-directions-line-4.text: Bayan na juya hagu, a wane gefe ɗakin karatun yake?

speakUnit-b1-directions-line-5.source: On your right, across from the park. The entrance is by the parking area.
speakUnit-b1-directions-line-5.text: A damanka, daura da wurin shaƙatawa. Mashigar tana kusa da wurin ajiye motoci.

speakUnit-b1-directions-word-3.source: In front of or across from

speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-1.source: I heard your suggestion that we meet in person every week.
speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-1.text: Na ji shawararka cewa mu riƙa haɗuwa kai tsaye kowane mako.

speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-2.source: Yes, so we can talk things through. What do you think?
speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-2.text: E, don mu tattauna abubuwa sosai. Me kake gani?

speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-3.source: I see your point, but some people can't attend every week.
speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-3.text: Na fahimci ra’ayinka, amma wasu ba za su iya zuwa kowane mako ba.

speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-4.source: Okay, do you have another idea that would work for the team?
speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-4.text: To, kana da wata shawarar da za ta dace da ƙungiyar?

speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-5.source: We could meet in person once a month and online the other weeks.
speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-5.text: Za mu iya haɗuwa kai tsaye sau ɗaya a wata, sannan mu yi taro ta intanet sauran makonnin.

speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-6.source: I think we can agree on that. Let's try it for a month.
speakUnit-b1-disagree-line-6.text: Ina ganin za mu iya amincewa da hakan. Mu gwada na wata ɗaya.

speakUnit-b1-faith-line-1.source: I just wanted to let you know I'm fasting today, in case you offer me coffee.
speakUnit-b1-faith-line-1.text: Na so in sanar da kai cewa ina azumi yau, idan za ka ba ni kofi.

speakUnit-b1-faith-line-2.source: Thanks for telling me. Can I ask what fasting means to you?
speakUnit-b1-faith-line-2.text: Na gode da ka faɗa mini. Zan iya tambayar abin da azumi yake nufi a gare ka?

speakUnit-b1-faith-line-3.source: For me, fasting is worship and a chance to focus on my prayers.
speakUnit-b1-faith-line-3.text: A gare ni, azumi ibada ne kuma dama ce ta mai da hankali ga sallolina.

speakUnit-b1-faith-line-4.source: I understand. Would you like us to schedule the meeting in the afternoon instead of at lunch?
speakUnit-b1-faith-line-4.text: Na fahimta. Kana son mu sa taron da rana bayan lokacin cin abinci?

speakUnit-b1-faith-line-5.source: The afternoon works for me. Thank you for understanding.
speakUnit-b1-faith-line-5.text: Da rana ya dace da ni. Na gode da ka fahimta.

speakUnit-b1-faith-line-6.source: You're welcome. Let's pick a time that works for both of us.
speakUnit-b1-faith-line-6.text: Babu komai. Mu zaɓi lokacin da ya dace da mu duka.

speakUnit-b1-faith-title.text: Magana game da imani cikin ladabi

speakUnit-b1-health-line-1.source: I'd like to explain my symptoms. The dizziness has been coming and going for two days.
speakUnit-b1-health-line-1.text: Ina son bayyana alamomin rashin lafiyata. Kwanaki biyu ina jin jiri lokaci-lokaci.

speakUnit-b1-health-line-2.source: When does the dizziness get worse? Do you have any other symptoms with it?
speakUnit-b1-health-line-2.text: Yaushe jirin yake ƙaruwa? Kana da wasu alamomi tare da shi?

speakUnit-b1-health-line-3.source: It gets worse when I stand up from a chair, and sometimes I feel nauseated.
speakUnit-b1-health-line-3.text: Yana ƙaruwa idan na tashi daga kujera, kuma wani lokaci ina jin tashin zuciya.

speakUnit-b1-health-line-4.source: Are you allergic to any medicines, or do you take any regularly?
speakUnit-b1-health-line-4.text: Akwai maganin da jikinka ba ya jituwa da shi, ko wani da kake sha a kai a kai?

speakUnit-b1-health-line-5.source: I'm allergic to penicillin. Here's a list of my medicines.
speakUnit-b1-health-line-5.text: Jikina ba ya jituwa da penicillin. Ga jerin magungunana.

speakUnit-b1-health-line-6.source: Thank you. I'll add the allergy and symptoms to your record.
speakUnit-b1-health-line-6.text: Na gode. Zan ƙara bayanin rashin jituwar da alamomin a kundinka.

speakUnit-b1-health-word-3.text: Rashin jituwar jiki da wani abu

speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-1.source: In the sermon I heard ‘I counsel you to be mindful of Allah.’ I'd like to understand the phrase.
speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-1.text: A huɗuba na ji «Ina yi muku wasiyya da ku ji tsoron Allah.» Ina son in fahimci jimlar.

speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-2.source: Start with the word ūṣīkum. What do you understand from it?
speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-2.text: Fara da kalmar ūṣīkum. Me ka fahimta daga gare ta?

speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-3.source: I understand that the speaker is offering advice to the people listening.
speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-3.text: Na fahimci cewa mai magana yana yi wa masu sauraro nasiha.

speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-4.source: Right. And what does ‘ammā baʿd’ signal in the sermon?
speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-4.text: Haka ne. Kuma mene ne «ammā baʿd» take nunawa a huɗuba?

speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-5.source: It signals a shift from the introduction to the subject of the sermon.
speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-5.text: Tana nuna an gama gabatarwa kuma za a fara ainihin batun huɗubar.

speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-6.source: Exactly. When you hear it, listen for the topic that follows.
speakUnit-b1-khutbah-line-6.text: Daidai. Idan ka ji ta, ka saurari batun da ke biye.

speakUnit-b1-khutbah-word-1.text: Tsoron Allah da lura da Shi

speakUnit-b1-news-line-1.source: Did you see the headline? It says the new station opens on Thursday.
speakUnit-b1-news-line-1.text: Ka ga kanun labarin? Ya ce za a buɗe sabuwar tashar ranar Alhamis.

speakUnit-b1-news-line-2.text: Alhamis ɗin nan ko mako na gaba?

speakUnit-b1-news-line-3.source: The article says next Thursday. The headline doesn't give the date.
speakUnit-b1-news-line-3.text: A cikin labarin an ce Alhamis ta mako na gaba. Kanun labarin bai ambaci ranar ba.

speakUnit-b1-news-line-4.source: Okay. Did they give an opening time?

speakUnit-b1-news-line-5.source: They haven't announced the time yet. Let's check before we go.
speakUnit-b1-news-line-5.text: Har yanzu ba su sanar da lokacin ba. Mu duba kafin mu tafi.

speakUnit-b1-news-line-6.source: Right. The details matter more than the headline alone.
speakUnit-b1-news-line-6.text: Haka ne. Cikakken bayani ya fi kanun labari kaɗai muhimmanci.

speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-1.source: What do you think about ordering vegetables online instead of going to the market?
speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-1.text: Me kake gani game da odar kayan lambu ta intanet maimakon zuwa kasuwa?

speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-2.source: I prefer the market because I can see the vegetables myself. What about you?
speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-2.text: Na fi son kasuwa domin zan iya ganin kayan lambun da kaina. Kai fa?

speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-3.source: I think delivery saves time, especially when we're busy.
speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-3.text: Ina ganin a kawo mana su yana rage lokacin da za mu kashe, musamman idan muna da aiki.

speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-4.source: True. But how do we know the vegetables are fresh?
speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-4.text: Gaskiya ne. Amma ta yaya za mu san ko kayan lambun sabbi ne?

speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-5.source: You have a point. Let's try a small order first and see.
speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-5.text: Akwai gaskiya a maganarka. Mu fara da odar kaɗan mu gani.

speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-6.source: Good idea. Then we can decide.
speakUnit-b1-opinions-line-6.text: Shawara ce mai kyau. Sai mu yanke shawara.

speakUnit-b1-opinions-sign.text: Odar kayan da za a kawo

speakUnit-b1-plans-line-1.source: Let's plan the meal distribution for Saturday. Are you free in the morning?
speakUnit-b1-plans-line-1.text: Mu tsara yadda za a raba abinci ranar Asabar. Kana da lokaci da safe?

speakUnit-b1-plans-line-2.source: I can come after ten. When do you want to start?
speakUnit-b1-plans-line-2.text: Zan iya zuwa bayan ƙarfe goma. Yaushe kake son mu fara?

speakUnit-b1-plans-line-3.source: Let's meet at eleven by the entrance.
speakUnit-b1-plans-line-3.text: Mu haɗu da ƙarfe goma sha ɗaya a mashigar.

speakUnit-b1-plans-line-4.source: Great. And if the car is late, what should we do?
speakUnit-b1-plans-line-4.text: Madalla. Idan motar ta makara, me za mu yi?

speakUnit-b1-plans-line-5.source: We'll start setting up and tell the team if the time changes.
speakUnit-b1-plans-line-5.text: Za mu fara shiri, mu kuma sanar da ƙungiyar idan lokacin ya canja.

speakUnit-b1-plans-line-6.source: Great. I'll send the plan to the group.
speakUnit-b1-plans-line-6.text: Madalla. Zan tura wa ƙungiyar tsarin.

speakUnit-b1-story-line-1.source: Yesterday I left my bag on the bus. I only noticed after I got off.
speakUnit-b1-story-line-1.text: Jiya na bar jakata a cikin bas. Sai bayan na sauka na lura.

speakUnit-b1-story-line-2.source: What did you do as soon as you noticed?
speakUnit-b1-story-line-2.text: Me ka yi da zarar ka lura?

speakUnit-b1-story-line-3.source: First I called the company. They wanted to know the bus number.
speakUnit-b1-story-line-3.text: Da farko na kira kamfanin. Suna son sanin lambar bas ɗin.

speakUnit-b1-story-line-4.source: Did you manage to find the number? How did the story end?
speakUnit-b1-story-line-4.text: Ka samu lambar? Yaya labarin ya ƙare?

speakUnit-b1-story-line-5.source: I found it on the ticket, and in the end they returned my bag.
speakUnit-b1-story-line-5.text: Na same ta a tikitin, kuma daga ƙarshe sun mayar mini da jakata.

speakUnit-b1-story-line-6.source: Thank God. Good thing you kept the ticket.
speakUnit-b1-story-line-6.text: Godiya ta tabbata ga Allah. Ka yi da ka riƙe tikitin.

speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-1.source: I promised the team I'd send the report today, but we're still missing some figures.
speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-1.text: Na yi wa ƙungiyar alƙawarin zan tura rahoton yau, amma har yanzu ba mu sami wasu ƙididdiga ba.

speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-2.source: Which part is missing? I might be able to help.
speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-2.text: Wane ɓangare ne ya rage? Wataƙila zan iya taimakawa.

speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-3.source: We're missing the total number of orders. Can you check the table with me?
speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-3.text: Ba mu sami jimillar adadin oda ba. Za ka duba jadawalin tare da ni?

speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-4.source: Sure. And if we don't finish it today, what do we tell the team?
speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-4.text: E. Idan ba mu gama yau ba, me za mu faɗa wa ƙungiyar?

speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-5.source: We'll send what we have and explain when we can finish the rest.
speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-5.text: Za mu tura abin da muke da shi mu bayyana lokacin da za mu gama sauran.

speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-6.source: Understood. Let's start with the total.
speakUnit-b1-workplace-line-6.text: Na fahimta. Mu fara da jimillar.

speakUnit-b1-workplace-word-3.text: Ba a samu ba ko bai cika ba

speakUnit-gulf-a1-directions-line-1.source: Excuse me, where's the visitor entrance?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-directions-line-1.text: A gafarta, ina mashigar baƙi take?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-directions-line-2.source: Ahead of you, on the right. See the blue door?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-directions-line-2.text: A gabanka, ta dama. Ka ga ƙofar shuɗi?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-directions-line-3.source: Yes, I see it. Do I go in through that door?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-directions-line-3.text: E, na gan ta. Ta wannan ƙofar zan shiga?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-food-line-1.source: I'd like to eat here. Do you have rice and chicken?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-food-line-1.text: Ina so in ci abinci a nan. Kuna da shinkafa da naman kaza?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-food-line-2.source: Yes, we do. Would you like something to drink?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-food-line-2.text: E, muna da shi. Kana son abin sha?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-food-line-4.source: Of course. Your food will be here shortly.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-food-line-4.text: To. Za a kawo abincinka nan ba da jimawa ba.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-food-sign.text: Odar abincin da za a tafi da shi

speakUnit-gulf-a1-greetings-line-1.source: Peace be upon you. How are you?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-greetings-line-2.source: And peace be upon you. I'm well, praise be to Allah. What's your name?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-greetings-line-2.text: Wa alaikumus salam. Ina lafiya, godiya ta tabbata ga Allah. Mene ne sunanka?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-greetings-line-3.source: My name's Sami. Nice to meet you.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-greetings-line-3.text: Sunana Sami. Na yi farin cikin haɗuwa da kai.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-greetings-line-4.text: Ni ma na yi farin ciki. Barka da zuwa.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-health-line-1.source: Excuse me, where's the clinic? My head hurts.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-health-line-1.text: A gafarta, ina asibitin yake? Ina jin ciwon kai.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-health-line-2.source: The clinic is on the first floor. Shall I show you where the lift is?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-health-line-2.text: Asibitin yana bene na farko. In nuna maka inda lif yake?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-health-line-3.source: Yes, please. I'd like to see the doctor.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-health-line-3.text: E, don Allah. Ina so in ga likita.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-health-line-4.source: The lift's here on your left. Hope you feel better soon.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-health-line-4.text: Lif yana nan a hagunka. Ina fatan ka ji sauƙi da wuri.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-help-line-1.source: Excuse me, I'm lost. Can you help me?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-help-line-1.text: A gafarta, na ɓace. Za ka iya taimaka mini?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-help-line-2.source: Of course. Where do you want to go?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-help-line-3.source: I want to go to the metro station. Can you show me on the map?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-help-line-3.text: Ina son zuwa tashar metro. Za ka iya nuna mini a taswira?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-help-line-4.source: Yes, you're here, and the station is there, next to the market.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-help-line-4.text: E, kana nan, tashar kuma tana can kusa da kasuwa.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-help-word-2.source: Can you help me? (to a man)
speakUnit-gulf-a1-help-word-2.text: Za ka iya taimaka mini? (ana magana da namiji)

speakUnit-gulf-a1-hotel-line-1.source: Peace be upon you. I have a booking under Sami.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-hotel-line-1.text: Assalamu alaikum. Na yi ajiyar ɗaki da sunan Sami.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-hotel-line-2.source: And peace be upon you. Your room is on the second floor. Do you have your passport with you?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-hotel-line-2.text: Wa alaikumus salam. Ɗakinka yana bene na biyu. Kana da fasfonka a tare da kai?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-hotel-line-3.source: Yes, here's my passport. Where's the lift?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-hotel-line-3.text: E, ga fasfona. Ina lif yake?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-hotel-line-4.source: The lift's on the right, by the stairs.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-hotel-line-4.text: Lif yana dama, kusa da matakala.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-money-line-1.source: Excuse me, how much is the bill?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-money-line-1.text: A gafarta, nawa ne zan biya?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-money-line-2.text: Dirhami hamsin. Da kati ko tsabar kuɗi?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-money-line-3.source: By card, please. I'd like the receipt too.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-money-line-3.text: Da kati, don Allah. Ina son rasidin ma.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-money-word-1.text: Lissafin kuɗin da za a biya

speakUnit-gulf-a1-mosque-line-1.source: Excuse me, is there a mosque near here?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-mosque-line-1.text: A gafarta, akwai masallaci kusa da nan?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-mosque-line-2.source: Yes, just past the white building. Do you see it?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-mosque-line-2.text: E, bayan farin ginin nan. Kana ganinsa?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-mosque-line-3.source: Yes, I see it. Where's the wudu area?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-mosque-line-3.text: E, ina ganinsa. Ina wurin alwala yake?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-mosque-line-4.source: On the left, next to the mosque door.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-mosque-line-4.text: A hagu, kusa da ƙofar masallacin.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-shopping-line-1.source: Is this the date market? I'd like a kilo of dates.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-shopping-line-1.text: Wannan kasuwar dabino ce? Ina son kilo ɗaya na dabino.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-shopping-line-2.source: Yes, welcome. We have these two kinds. Would you like a taste?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-shopping-line-2.text: E, barka da zuwa. Muna da waɗannan nau’o’i biyu. Kana son ɗanɗanawa?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-shopping-line-3.source: This one's very sweet. I'd like this kind, please.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-shopping-line-3.text: Wannan yana da zaƙi sosai. Ina son irin wannan, don Allah.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-shopping-line-4.source: Of course. I'll put a kilo in the bag for you.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-shopping-line-4.text: To. Zan sa kilo ɗaya a jaka.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-sim-line-1.source: I'd like a SIM card for my phone.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-sim-line-1.text: Ina son katin SIM na wayata.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-sim-line-2.source: Do you want data only, or data and calls?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-sim-line-2.text: Intanet kawai kake so, ko intanet da kira?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-sim-line-3.source: Data only. Do you have a one-week plan?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-sim-line-3.text: Intanet kawai. Kuna da kunshin mako ɗaya?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-sim-line-4.source: Yes, we do. It works from now.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-sim-line-4.text: E, muna da shi. Zai fara aiki daga yanzu.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-time-line-1.source: What time do you open tomorrow?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-time-line-1.text: Da ƙarfe nawa kuke buɗewa gobe?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-time-line-2.source: We open at nine in the morning. Would you like to come in the morning?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-time-line-2.text: Muna buɗewa da ƙarfe tara na safe. Kana son zuwa da safe?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-time-line-3.source: No, I'll come in the afternoon. When do you close?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-time-line-3.text: A’a, zan zo da rana. Yaushe kuke rufewa?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-time-line-4.source: We close at six in the evening.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-time-line-4.text: Muna rufewa da ƙarfe shida na yamma.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-transport-line-1.source: Excuse me, where do I catch the bus to the airport?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-transport-line-1.text: A gafarta, ina zan hau bas ɗin zuwa filin jirgin sama?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-transport-line-2.source: At this stop. It's about a fifteen-minute wait.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-transport-line-2.text: A wannan tashar. Za ka jira kimanin minti goma sha biyar.

speakUnit-gulf-a1-transport-line-3.source: Okay, I'll wait here. Do I pay when I get on?
speakUnit-gulf-a1-transport-line-3.text: To, zan jira a nan. Zan biya lokacin da na shiga?

speakUnit-gulf-a1-transport-line-4.source: Yes, tap your card on the reader by the door.
speakUnit-gulf-a1-transport-line-4.text: E, taɓa na’urar da ke kusa da ƙofar da katinka.

speakUnit-gulf-work-concern-line-1.source: I have a problem at work. Who can I speak with?
speakUnit-gulf-work-concern-line-1.text: Ina da matsala a wurin aiki. Da wa zan iya magana?

speakUnit-gulf-work-concern-line-2.source: You can speak with me. Would you like to make a complaint?
speakUnit-gulf-work-concern-line-2.text: Za ka iya magana da ni. Kana son ka gabatar da ƙorafi?

speakUnit-gulf-work-concern-line-3.source: I'd like to understand the process first. Can we speak somewhere private?
speakUnit-gulf-work-concern-line-3.text: Ina son in fahimci tsarin da farko. Za mu iya magana inda za mu keɓe?

speakUnit-gulf-work-concern-line-4.source: Yes, we can speak in the office.
speakUnit-gulf-work-concern-line-4.text: E, za mu iya magana a ofis.

speakUnit-gulf-work-contract-line-1.source: Is this the employment contract? Could I have a copy?
speakUnit-gulf-work-contract-line-1.text: Wannan kwangilar aiki ce? Zan iya samun kwafi?

speakUnit-gulf-work-contract-line-2.source: Yes. Would you like to read it now?
speakUnit-gulf-work-contract-line-2.text: E. Kana son karanta ta yanzu?

speakUnit-gulf-work-contract-line-3.source: Yes, I'd like to read it before I sign. Could you explain this clause?
speakUnit-gulf-work-contract-line-3.text: E, ina son karanta ta kafin in sa hannu. Za ka iya bayyana mini wannan sashe?

speakUnit-gulf-work-contract-line-4.source: Of course. Point to the clause you'd like to understand.
speakUnit-gulf-work-contract-line-4.text: Tabbas. Nuna sashen da kake son fahimta.

speakUnit-gulf-work-first-day-line-1.source: Peace be upon you. I'm new here. My name's Sami.
speakUnit-gulf-work-first-day-line-1.text: Assalamu alaikum. Ni sabon ma’aikaci ne a nan. Sunana Sami.

speakUnit-gulf-work-first-day-line-2.source: And peace be upon you. Welcome. Which department do you work in?
speakUnit-gulf-work-first-day-line-2.text: Wa alaikumus salam. Barka da zuwa. A wane sashe kake aiki?

speakUnit-gulf-work-first-day-line-3.source: I work in the stockroom. Where's the staff entrance?
speakUnit-gulf-work-first-day-line-3.text: Ina aiki a wurin ajiyar kaya. Ina mashigar ma’aikata take?

speakUnit-gulf-work-first-day-line-4.source: Through this door. Come, I'll show you where you'll be working.
speakUnit-gulf-work-first-day-line-4.text: Ta wannan ƙofar. Zo in nuna maka inda za ka yi aiki.

speakUnit-gulf-work-instructions-line-1.source: I'm unsure how to use this equipment.
speakUnit-gulf-work-instructions-line-1.text: Ban tabbatar da yadda ake amfani da wannan kayan aikin ba.

speakUnit-gulf-work-instructions-line-2.source: I'm glad you asked. Shall I explain before you start?
speakUnit-gulf-work-instructions-line-2.text: Na ji daɗin tambayarka. In yi bayani kafin ka fara?

speakUnit-gulf-work-instructions-line-3.source: Yes, please. Could you show me the safety instructions?
speakUnit-gulf-work-instructions-line-3.text: E, don Allah. Za ka iya nuna mini umarnin kariya daga haɗari?

speakUnit-gulf-work-instructions-line-4.source: Of course. We'll read them together before you start work.
speakUnit-gulf-work-instructions-line-4.text: Tabbas. Za mu karanta shi tare kafin ka fara aiki.

speakUnit-gulf-work-interview-line-1.source: I'd like to apply for the job. I have an appointment today.
speakUnit-gulf-work-interview-line-1.text: Ina son neman aikin. Ina da alƙawarin ganawa yau.

speakUnit-gulf-work-interview-line-2.source: Yes, come in. Do you have experience in this kind of work?
speakUnit-gulf-work-interview-line-2.text: E, shigo. Ka taɓa yin irin wannan aikin?

speakUnit-gulf-work-interview-line-3.source: Yes, I worked in a stockroom for two years. Here's my CV.
speakUnit-gulf-work-interview-line-3.text: E, na yi aiki a wurin ajiyar kaya shekara biyu. Ga takardar tarihin aikina.

speakUnit-gulf-work-interview-line-4.source: Thank you. We'll look it over and get back to you.
speakUnit-gulf-work-interview-line-4.text: Na gode. Za mu duba ta mu sake tuntuɓarka.

speakUnit-gulf-work-interview-partner.text: Mai yin hira da mai neman aiki

speakUnit-gulf-work-leave-line-1.source: I'd like to ask for permission. Could I take Thursday off?
speakUnit-gulf-work-leave-line-1.text: Ina son neman izini. Zan iya yin hutun aiki ranar Alhamis?

speakUnit-gulf-work-leave-line-2.source: Which day will you be back at work?
speakUnit-gulf-work-leave-line-2.text: Wace rana za ka dawo aiki?

speakUnit-gulf-work-leave-line-3.source: I'll be back Friday. Where do I submit the request?
speakUnit-gulf-work-leave-line-3.text: Zan dawo ranar Juma’a. Ina zan kai takardar neman izinin?

speakUnit-gulf-work-leave-line-4.source: Fill in the request and email it to me.
speakUnit-gulf-work-leave-line-4.text: Cika takardar neman izinin ka turo mini ta imel.

speakUnit-gulf-work-overtime-line-1.source: I worked two extra hours yesterday. Where do I log them?
speakUnit-gulf-work-overtime-line-1.text: Na yi ƙarin awa biyu a aiki jiya. Ina zan rubuta su?

speakUnit-gulf-work-overtime-line-2.source: In the work log. Do you have your start and finish times?
speakUnit-gulf-work-overtime-line-2.text: A kundin lokutan aiki. Kana da lokutan farawa da gamawa?

speakUnit-gulf-work-overtime-line-3.source: Yes, I wrote them down here. Can you check the hours with me?
speakUnit-gulf-work-overtime-line-3.text: E, na rubuta su a nan. Za ka duba lokutan tare da ni?

speakUnit-gulf-work-overtime-line-4.source: Yes, bring the log and we'll check it together.
speakUnit-gulf-work-overtime-line-4.text: E, kawo kundin mu duba tare.

speakUnit-gulf-work-pay-line-1.source: Could I have this month's payslip?
speakUnit-gulf-work-pay-line-1.text: Zan iya samun takardar albashin wannan watan?

speakUnit-gulf-work-pay-line-2.source: Yes, here's the payslip. Which amount would you like to check?
speakUnit-gulf-work-pay-line-2.text: E, ga takardar albashin. Wane adadi kake son dubawa?

speakUnit-gulf-work-pay-line-3.source: I'd like to check my take-home pay. What does this deduction mean?
speakUnit-gulf-work-pay-line-3.text: Ina son duba kuɗin da zan karɓa bayan cire-cire. Mene ne wannan abin da aka cire?

speakUnit-gulf-work-pay-line-4.source: Let's go through the items one at a time.
speakUnit-gulf-work-pay-line-4.text: Mu duba bayanan ɗaya bayan ɗaya.

speakUnit-gulf-work-rights-line-1.source: Excuse me, where can I ask about my rights at work?
speakUnit-gulf-work-rights-line-1.text: A gafarta, ina zan iya tambaya game da haƙƙoƙina a wurin aiki?

speakUnit-gulf-work-rights-line-2.source: Would you like the number for the office that handles this?
speakUnit-gulf-work-rights-line-2.text: Kana son lambar ofishin da yake kula da wannan?

speakUnit-gulf-work-rights-line-3.source: Yes, please write it down. I'd like to ask if they have an interpreter.
speakUnit-gulf-work-rights-line-3.text: E, rubuta mini, don Allah. Ina so in tambaya ko suna da mai fassarar zance.

speakUnit-gulf-work-rights-line-4.source: Here's the number. When you call, tell them which language you speak.
speakUnit-gulf-work-rights-line-4.text: Ga lambar. Idan ka kira su, ka faɗa musu yaren da kake magana da shi.

speakUnit-gulf-work-shifts-line-1.source: What time does my shift start tomorrow?
speakUnit-gulf-work-shifts-line-1.text: Da ƙarfe nawa lokacina na aiki zai fara gobe?

speakUnit-gulf-work-shifts-line-2.source: Seven in the morning. Did you get the new schedule?
speakUnit-gulf-work-shifts-line-2.text: Da ƙarfe bakwai na safe. Ka sami sabon jadawalin?

speakUnit-gulf-work-shifts-line-3.source: Not yet. Can you send it to me?
speakUnit-gulf-work-shifts-line-3.text: Har yanzu ban samu ba. Za ka iya turo mini?

speakUnit-gulf-work-shifts-line-4.source: Yes, I'll send it to you now.

speakUnit-msa-a1-directions-line-1.source: Excuse me, where is the exit?
speakUnit-msa-a1-directions-line-1.text: A gafarta, ina hanyar fita take?

speakUnit-msa-a1-directions-line-2.source: At the end of the corridor. Do you see the green door?
speakUnit-msa-a1-directions-line-2.text: A ƙarshen hanyar cikin ginin. Ka ga koriyar ƙofar?

speakUnit-msa-a1-directions-line-3.source: Yes, I see it. Do I turn left there?
speakUnit-msa-a1-directions-line-3.text: E, na gan ta. In juya hagu a can?

speakUnit-msa-a1-directions-line-4.source: Yes. After the door, turn left.

speakUnit-msa-a1-food-line-2.source: Here you go. What would you like to drink?
speakUnit-msa-a1-food-line-2.text: Ga shi. Me kake son sha?

speakUnit-msa-a1-food-line-3.source: I'd like water without ice, please.
speakUnit-msa-a1-food-line-3.text: Ina son ruwa ba tare da ƙanƙara ba, don Allah.

speakUnit-msa-a1-food-line-4.source: Certainly. I'll bring the water now.

speakUnit-msa-a1-greetings-line-1.source: Good morning. I'm a new visitor.
speakUnit-msa-a1-greetings-line-1.text: Barka da safiya. Wannan ne karon farko da na zo.

speakUnit-msa-a1-greetings-line-2.source: Good morning. Do you need any help?
speakUnit-msa-a1-greetings-line-2.text: Barka da safiya. Kana buƙatar taimako?

speakUnit-msa-a1-greetings-line-3.source: Yes, please. Where is the reception desk?
speakUnit-msa-a1-greetings-line-3.text: E, don Allah. Ina teburin tarba yake?

speakUnit-msa-a1-greetings-line-4.source: The reception desk is in front of you. Welcome.
speakUnit-msa-a1-greetings-line-4.text: Teburin tarba yana a gabanka. Barka da zuwa.

speakUnit-msa-a1-health-line-1.source: I feel unwell. Where can I find a doctor?
speakUnit-msa-a1-health-line-1.text: Ba na jin daɗi. Ina zan sami likita?

speakUnit-msa-a1-health-line-2.source: The clinic is on the first floor. Can you go upstairs?
speakUnit-msa-a1-health-line-2.text: Asibitin yana bene na farko. Za ka iya hawa sama?

speakUnit-msa-a1-health-line-3.source: Yes. Where is the lift, please?
speakUnit-msa-a1-health-line-3.text: E. Ina lif yake, don Allah?

speakUnit-msa-a1-health-line-4.source: The lift is by the entrance. I hope you feel better.
speakUnit-msa-a1-health-line-4.text: Lif yana kusa da mashiga. Ina fatan ka ji sauƙi.

speakUnit-msa-a1-help-line-1.source: Can you help me? I can't find my phone.
speakUnit-msa-a1-help-line-1.text: Za ka iya taimaka mini? Ban ga wayata ba.

speakUnit-msa-a1-help-line-2.source: Of course. Do you remember where you last saw it?
speakUnit-msa-a1-help-line-2.text: E. Ka tuna inda ka gan ta a ƙarshe?

speakUnit-msa-a1-help-line-3.source: Yes, it was on the table by the entrance.
speakUnit-msa-a1-help-line-3.text: E, tana kan teburin da ke kusa da mashiga.

speakUnit-msa-a1-help-line-4.source: Okay. Let's ask at lost and found.
speakUnit-msa-a1-help-line-4.text: To. Mu tambaya a sashen kayan da suka ɓace.

speakUnit-msa-a1-hotel-line-1.source: Good evening. I have a reservation at the hotel.
speakUnit-msa-a1-hotel-line-1.text: Barka da yamma. Na yi ajiyar ɗaki a otal ɗin.

speakUnit-msa-a1-hotel-line-2.source: Welcome. Do you have your booking confirmation?
speakUnit-msa-a1-hotel-line-2.text: Barka da zuwa. Kana da takardar tabbatar da ajiyar ɗakin?

speakUnit-msa-a1-hotel-line-3.source: Yes, here it is. What's my room number?
speakUnit-msa-a1-hotel-line-3.text: E, ga ta. Mene ne lambar ɗakina?

speakUnit-msa-a1-hotel-line-4.source: Your room number is 105. Here's the key.

speakUnit-msa-a1-money-line-2.source: Ten riyals. Would you like one ticket?
speakUnit-msa-a1-money-line-2.text: Riyal goma. Kana son tikiti ɗaya?

speakUnit-msa-a1-money-line-3.source: Yes, one ticket. Can I pay by card?
speakUnit-msa-a1-money-line-3.text: E, tikiti ɗaya. Zan iya biya da kati?

speakUnit-msa-a1-mosque-line-1.source: Peace be upon you. Where is the wudu area?
speakUnit-msa-a1-mosque-line-1.text: Assalamu alaikum. Ina wurin alwala yake?

speakUnit-msa-a1-mosque-line-2.source: And peace be upon you. Beside the mosque. Do you see the blue sign?
speakUnit-msa-a1-mosque-line-2.text: Wa alaikumus salam. Yana kusa da masallaci. Ka ga allon shuɗi?

speakUnit-msa-a1-mosque-line-3.source: Yes, I see it. Is the entrance under the sign?
speakUnit-msa-a1-mosque-line-3.text: E, na gan shi. Mashigar tana ƙarƙashin allon?

speakUnit-msa-a1-shopping-line-1.source: I'd like to buy this shirt. Do you have a larger size?
speakUnit-msa-a1-shopping-line-1.text: Ina son sayen wannan rigar. Kuna da wadda ta fi girma?

speakUnit-msa-a1-shopping-line-2.source: Yes. Would you like the same colour?
speakUnit-msa-a1-shopping-line-2.text: E. Kana son launi iri ɗaya?

speakUnit-msa-a1-shopping-line-3.text: E, irin wannan launin, don Allah.

speakUnit-msa-a1-shopping-line-4.source: Here you go. You can pay at the checkout.
speakUnit-msa-a1-shopping-line-4.text: Ga ta. Za ka iya biya a wajen karɓar kuɗi.

speakUnit-msa-a1-sim-line-1.source: I'd like a SIM card for my phone, please.
speakUnit-msa-a1-sim-line-1.text: Ina son katin SIM na wayata, don Allah.

speakUnit-msa-a1-sim-line-2.source: Would you like a package with internet?
speakUnit-msa-a1-sim-line-2.text: Kana son kunshin da ke da intanet?

speakUnit-msa-a1-sim-line-3.source: Yes, I'd like a package for one week.
speakUnit-msa-a1-sim-line-3.text: E, ina son kunshin mako ɗaya.

speakUnit-msa-a1-sim-line-4.source: This package is valid for seven days.
speakUnit-msa-a1-sim-line-4.text: Wannan kunshin yana aiki na kwanaki bakwai.

speakUnit-msa-a1-time-line-1.source: What time does the office open tomorrow?
speakUnit-msa-a1-time-line-1.text: Da ƙarfe nawa ofishin yake buɗewa gobe?

speakUnit-msa-a1-time-line-2.source: It opens at nine. Are you coming in the morning?
speakUnit-msa-a1-time-line-2.text: Yana buɗewa da ƙarfe tara. Za ka zo da safe?

speakUnit-msa-a1-time-line-3.text: E, zan zo da ƙarfe goma.

speakUnit-msa-a1-time-line-4.source: Okay. The office is open until noon.
speakUnit-msa-a1-time-line-4.text: To. Ofishin yana buɗe har tsakar rana.

speakUnit-msa-a1-transport-line-1.source: Does this bus go to the station?
speakUnit-msa-a1-transport-line-1.text: Wannan bas ɗin yana zuwa tashar?

speakUnit-msa-a1-transport-line-2.source: Yes. Do you have a ticket?

speakUnit-msa-a1-transport-line-3.source: Yes, here's my ticket. Can I board now?
speakUnit-msa-a1-transport-line-3.text: E, ga tikitina. Zan iya hawa yanzu?

speakUnit-msa-a1-transport-line-4.source: Come aboard. We'll reach the station shortly.
speakUnit-msa-a1-transport-line-4.text: Shigo. Za mu isa tashar nan ba da jimawa ba.

speakUnit-sim-line-1.source: Peace be upon you. I’d like a SIM card, please.
speakUnit-sim-line-1.text: Assalamu alaikum. Ina son katin SIM, don Allah.

speakUnit-sim-line-2.source: And peace be upon you. Do you want an internet package?
speakUnit-sim-line-2.text: Wa alaikumus salam. Kana son kunshin intanet?

speakUnit-sim-line-4.source: Fifty riyals. I need your passport.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-access-line-2.source: Of course, I'll bring you a wheelchair. Do you want to go up?
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-access-line-2.text: E, zan kawo maka keken guragu. Kana son hawa sama?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-access-line-4.source: Follow the lift sign. I'll come with you.
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-access-line-4.text: Bi alamar lif. Zan tafi tare da kai.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-gates-line-2.source: Do you want to go in or get out?
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-gates-line-2.text: Kana son shiga ne ko fita?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-gates-line-4.source: Look for the sign that says 'exit'.
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-gates-line-4.text: Nemi allon da ke cewa «Wurin fita».

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-haram-line-2.source: This way. Do you have a map?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-haram-line-4.source: Of course. Look, you're here, and this is the Haram.
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-haram-line-4.text: E. Duba, kana nan, kuma ga Harami.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-help-line-2.source: You're welcome here. Do you have a number for someone in your group?
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-help-line-2.text: Barka da zuwa. Kana da lambar wani daga rukuninka?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-help-line-4.source: Of course. Have a seat here while I call them.
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-help-line-4.text: E. Zauna a nan, zan kira su.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-help-title.text: Idan ka rabu da abokan tafiyarka

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-hotel-line-2.source: We'll replace your key. Do you need anything else?
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-hotel-line-2.text: Za mu sauya maka mabuɗin. Kana buƙatar wani abu?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-hotel-line-4.source: Of course. We'll send them to your room.
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-hotel-line-4.text: E. Za mu kai su ɗakinka.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-prayer-line-2.source: The wudu area is nearby. Are you looking for the prayer area too?
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-prayer-line-2.text: Wurin alwala yana kusa. Kana neman wurin salla ma?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-prayer-line-4.source: This sign points you to the women's prayer area.
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-prayer-line-4.text: Wannan allon yana nuna hanyar zuwa wurin sallar mata.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-transport-line-2.source: The station is a little far. Do you want to take a taxi?
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-transport-line-2.text: Tashar tana da ɗan nisa. Kana son hawa taksi?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-transport-line-4.source: Get in by the taxi sign.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-water-line-2.source: Here by the sign. Would you like a cup?
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-water-line-2.text: A nan, kusa da allon. Kana son kofi?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-water-line-4.source: Here you go. Here's a cup of water.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-wayfinding-line-2.source: This is the way to the Masʿā. Do you also want to know where the Maṭāf is?
speakUnit-umrah-hajj-wayfinding-line-2.text: Wannan ita ce hanyar zuwa wurin sa’ayi. Kana kuma son sanin inda wurin ɗawafi yake?

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-wayfinding-line-4.text: Bi allon da ke nuna wurin ɗawafi.

speakUnit-umrah-hajj-wayfinding-title.text: Hanyoyin zuwa wuraren sa’ayi da ɗawafi

tajweedHint-ghunnah-mim.source: Bring the lips together and hold the nasal sound on the mīm.
tajweedHint-ghunnah-mim.text: Haɗa leɓɓanka ka riƙe sautin hanci yayin furta mīm.

tajweedHint-ghunnah-nun.source: Hold the nasal sound on the nūn before moving to the next sound.
tajweedHint-ghunnah-nun.text: Riƙe sautin hanci yayin furta nūn kafin ka wuce zuwa sauti na gaba.

tajweedHint-heavy-light.source: Keep the sound light in these letters. The rāʾ and lām in Allah’s name have their own contextual rules.
tajweedHint-heavy-light.text: Furta waɗannan haruffan da siririn sauti. Rāʾ da lām na sunan Allah suna da ƙa’idojinsu bisa inda suka zo.

tajweedHint-heavy-raised.source: Raise the back of the tongue toward the palate. These seven letters keep their heaviness.
tajweedHint-heavy-raised.text: Ɗaga bayan harshe zuwa rufin baki. Waɗannan haruffa bakwai suna da kaurin sauti a ko da yaushe.

tajweedHint-idgham.source: Merge into the next letter. Use ghunnah with yāʾ, nūn, mīm or wāw.
tajweedHint-idgham.text: Haɗa sautin da harafi na gaba. Yi ghunnah da yāʾ, nūn, mīm ko wāw.

tajweedHint-ikhfa.source: Soften the nūn sound with ghunnah before the next letter.
tajweedHint-ikhfa.text: Sassauta sautin nūn da ghunnah kafin harafi na gaba.

tajweedHint-iqlab.source: Change the nūn sound to a soft mīm with ghunnah before bāʾ.
tajweedHint-iqlab.text: Mayar da sautin nūn zuwa mīm mai laushi tare da ghunnah kafin bāʾ.

tajweedHint-lam-moon.source: Pronounce the lām with sukūn and then read the next letter.
tajweedHint-lam-moon.text: Furta lām mai sukuni sannan ka karanta harafi na gaba.

tajweedHint-lam-sun.source: The lām merges into the next letter, which has a shaddah.
tajweedHint-lam-sun.text: Lām tana haɗewa da harafi na gaba, wanda yake da shadda.

tajweedHint-madd-connected.source: The long vowel and the following hamzah are in the same word.
tajweedHint-madd-connected.text: Dogon wasali da hamzar da ke biye da shi suna a kalma ɗaya.

tajweedHint-madd-natural.source: Hold the long vowel for two counts when nothing calls for further lengthening.
tajweedHint-madd-natural.text: Tsawaita dogon wasalin gwargwadon ƙidaya biyu idan babu abin da ke sa a ƙara tsawaita shi.

tajweedHint-madd-necessary.source: Hold for six counts before a permanent sukūn, such as the first half of the doubled lām in this word.
tajweedHint-madd-necessary.text: Tsawaita gwargwadon ƙidaya shida kafin sukuni na dindindin, kamar rabin farko na lām mai shadda a wannan kalmar.

tajweedHint-madd-separated.source: The first word ends with a long vowel and the next begins with a pronounced hamzah.
tajweedHint-madd-separated.text: Kalmar farko tana ƙarewa da dogon wasali, ta gaba tana farawa da hamzar da ake furtawa.

tajweedHint-madd-stop.source: A stop can leave a temporary sukūn after a long vowel. In this case two, four or six counts are taught.
tajweedHint-madd-stop.text: Idan ka tsaya, sukuni na ɗan lokaci na iya zuwa bayan dogon wasali. A wannan yanayin ana koyar da ƙidaya biyu, huɗu ko shida.

tajweedHint-makhraj-lips.source: The lips meet for bāʾ and mīm, round for consonant wāw, and the lower lip meets the upper teeth for fāʾ.
tajweedHint-makhraj-lips.text: Leɓɓa suna haɗuwa wajen furta bāʾ da mīm, suna zagayawa wajen furta wāw a matsayin baƙin harafi, kuma leɓen ƙasa yana haɗuwa da haƙoran sama wajen furta fāʾ.

tajweedHint-makhraj-mouth.source: The long vowels ā, ū and ī use the open space of the mouth and throat.
tajweedHint-makhraj-mouth.text: Dogayen wasalai ā, ū da ī suna fitowa daga sararin baki da maƙogwaro.

tajweedHint-makhraj-nose.source: Ghunnah is the nasal sound heard clearly on nūn or mīm with shaddah.
tajweedHint-makhraj-nose.text: Ghunnah sautin hanci ne da ake ji sosai a kan nūn ko mīm mai shadda.

tajweedHint-makhraj-throat.source: The six throat letters come from three different points, from deep in the throat to the part nearest the mouth.
tajweedHint-makhraj-throat.text: Haruffan maƙogwaro guda shida suna fitowa daga wurare uku, daga can ƙasan maƙogwaro zuwa wurin da ya fi kusa da baki.

tajweedHint-makhraj-tongue.source: The back, middle, side and tip of the tongue make different sounds against the palate, gums and teeth.
tajweedHint-makhraj-tongue.text: Baya, tsakiya, gefe da kan harshe suna samar da sautuka dabam-dabam a rufin baki, gindin haƙora da haƙora.

tajweedHint-mim-clear.source: Before letters other than bāʾ and mīm, say the mīm clearly.
tajweedHint-mim-clear.text: Kafin haruffan da ba bāʾ ko mīm ba, furta mīm a sarari.

tajweedHint-mim-hide.source: Before bāʾ, soften the mīm with ghunnah.
tajweedHint-mim-hide.text: Kafin bāʾ, sassauta mīm tare da ghunnah.

tajweedHint-mim-merge.source: Before another mīm, merge into one doubled mīm with ghunnah.
tajweedHint-mim-merge.text: Kafin wata mīm, haɗa mīm biyun su zama mīm mai shadda tare da ghunnah.

tajweedHint-qalqalah-inside.source: Release the sākin letter gently as you continue through the word.
tajweedHint-qalqalah-inside.text: Saki harafin mai sukuni a hankali yayin da kake ci gaba da karanta kalmar.

tajweedHint-qalqalah-stop.source: Release the final letter when you stop. Avoid adding a vowel.

tajweedHint-ra-heavy.text: Karanta rāʾ mai fat’ha ko damma da sauti mai kauri.

tajweedHint-script-iqlab.source: The small mīm signals iqlāb before bāʾ. Notice the extra sukūn on nūn in the IndoPak edition here.
