tajweedHint-script-maddah.source: The marks above the vowel have different shapes in the two editions. Use the madd rule for the surrounding letters to find the length.
tajweedHint-script-maddah.text: Alamomin saman wasalin suna da siffofi dabam a rubutu biyun. Yi amfani da ƙa’idar maddi ta haruffan da ke kewaye da shi don gano tsawonsa.

tajweedHint-script-pair.source: Look for the two clusters of three dots in both lines. If you pause at one, continue through the other.
tajweedHint-script-pair.text: Duba rukunonin ɗigogi uku guda biyu a duk layukan. Idan ka tsaya a ɗaya, ci gaba a ɗayan.

tajweedHint-script-wasl.source: Uthmani marks the connecting alif with a small ṣād shape. Our IndoPak edition writes it differently. Sound the hamzah when you begin at it. Skip it after a preceding sound, including an attached wa-.
tajweedHint-script-wasl.text: Rubutun Usmani yana nuna alif na haɗi da siffar ƙaramar ṣād. A IndoPak ɗinmu ana rubuta shi dabam. Furta hamzar idan ka fara daga gare ta. Tsallake ta idan wani sauti ya gabace ta, ciki har da wa- da aka liƙa.

tajweedHint-sifat-hams.source: Allow the breath to pass as you pronounce the letter. It is easiest to notice with sukūn.
tajweedHint-sifat-hams.text: Bar numfashi ya gudana yayin furta harafin. An fi gane shi idan yana da sukuni.

tajweedHint-sifat-jahr.source: The breath is held back at the articulation point. The letters shown are examples.
tajweedHint-sifat-jahr.text: Ana riƙe numfashi a wurin fitowar harafin. Haruffan da aka nuna misalai ne.

tajweedHint-sifat-rikhwah.source: Sound can continue through the articulation point. The letters shown are examples.
tajweedHint-sifat-rikhwah.text: Sauti yana iya ci gaba a wurin fitowar harafin. Haruffan da aka nuna misalai ne.

tajweedHint-sifat-shiddah.source: The articulation closes and briefly stops the stream of sound.
tajweedHint-sifat-shiddah.text: Wurin fitowar harafin yana rufewa ya ɗan tsayar da gudun sauti.

tajweedHint-sifat-tawassut.source: The sound flows in between the firm closure of shiddah and the continuation of rikhwah.
tajweedHint-sifat-tawassut.text: Gudun sauti yana tsakanin cikakkiyar rufewar shidda da ci gaban rikhwa.

tajweedHint-waqf-avoid.source: Continue through this mark when you can. Ask your teacher where to restart if you run out of breath.
tajweedHint-waqf-avoid.text: Ci gaba ta wannan alamar idan za ka iya. Idan numfashinka ya ƙare, tambayi malaminka inda za ka sake farawa.

tajweedHint-waqf-choice.source: You may pause or keep reading.
tajweedHint-waqf-choice.text: Kana iya tsayawa ko ci gaba da karatu.

tajweedHint-waqf-continue.source: Keep reading if you can. You may pause here if needed.
tajweedHint-waqf-continue.text: Ci gaba da karatu idan za ka iya. Kana iya tsayawa a nan idan akwai buƙata.

tajweedHint-waqf-pair.source: If you pause at the first mark, continue through the second. You may instead pause at the second.
tajweedHint-waqf-pair.text: Idan ka tsaya a alamar farko, ci gaba a ta biyu. Kana iya zaɓar tsayawa a ta biyu.

tajweedHint-waqf-pause.source: Pausing is preferred here. You may also continue.
tajweedHint-waqf-pause.text: An fi son tsayawa a nan. Kana kuma iya ci gaba.

tajweedHint-waqf-required.source: Pause to keep the meanings on either side distinct.
tajweedHint-waqf-required.text: Tsaya don ma’anonin ɓangarorin biyu su bambanta.

tajweedIntro-ghunnah.source: A shaddah doubles a letter. In this lesson, listen for the nasal sound held for two counts on doubled nūn or mīm.
tajweedIntro-ghunnah.text: Shadda tana ninka harafi. A wannan darasin, saurari sautin hanci da ake riƙewa gwargwadon ƙidaya biyu a kan nūn ko mīm mai shadda.

tajweedIntro-heavy-letters.source: Listen to the difference between ṣād and sīn. The seven istiʿlāʾ letters have a fuller sound, whose strength changes with the vowel.
tajweedIntro-heavy-letters.text: Saurari bambanci tsakanin ṣād da sīn. Haruffan isti’ila bakwai suna da sauti mai kauri, wanda ƙarfinsa ke canjawa bisa wasali.

tajweedIntro-lam.source: Look at the first letter after the definite article al-. It tells you whether the lām is pronounced or merges into the next letter.
tajweedIntro-lam.text: Duba harafi na farko bayan al-. Shi yake nuna ko a furta lām ko a haɗa ta da harafi na gaba.

tajweedIntro-madd.source: Hear when a vowel is held longer. The examples follow Ḥafṣ. A teacher can help you keep the count consistent with the way you recite.
tajweedIntro-madd.text: Saurari lokacin da ake tsawaita wasali. Misalan suna bin karatun Hafs. Malami zai iya taimaka maka ka daidaita ƙidaya bisa yadda kake karatu.

tajweedIntro-makharij.source: Start with the five regions in Ibn al-Jazarī’s system. The throat, tongue and lips contain several distinct articulation points.
tajweedIntro-makharij.text: Fara da sassa biyar a tsarin Ibn al-Jazari. Maƙogwaro, harshe da leɓɓa suna da wurare dabam-dabam da haruffa suke fitowa.

tajweedIntro-mim.source: Look at the letter after a mīm with sukūn. The next letter tells you whether to hide, merge or pronounce the mīm clearly.
tajweedIntro-mim.text: Duba harafin da ke bayan mīm mai sukuni. Harafi na gaba yana nuna ko a ɓoye sautin mīm, a haɗa shi, ko a furta shi a sarari.

tajweedIntro-mushaf-marks.source: Compare the same Quran passage in the two editions used here. Look at the mark and its surrounding words before deciding how to read.
tajweedIntro-mushaf-marks.text: Kwatanta ɓangaren Alƙur’ani ɗaya a tsarin rubutu biyun da ake amfani da su a nan. Duba alamar da kalmomin da ke kewaye da ita kafin ka yanke yadda za ka karanta.

tajweedIntro-qalqalah.source: Listen for a small release on the five qalqalah letters when they have sukūn. At a stop, a final vowel drops and the release is easier to hear.
tajweedIntro-qalqalah.text: Saurari ɗan sakin sauti a haruffan ƙalƙala guda biyar idan suna da sukuni. Idan an tsaya, wasalin ƙarshe yana faɗuwa, kuma an fi jin sakin sautin.

tajweedIntro-ra.source: Read rāʾ heavy with fatḥah or ḍammah and light with kasrah. For rāʾ with sukūn, a preceding fatḥah, ḍammah or temporary kasrah makes it heavy. An original kasrah in the same word usually makes it light. An emphatic letter that follows in the same word can make it heavy. When stopping with sukūn, a preceding sākin yāʾ keeps rāʾ light. If another sākin letter comes before rāʾ, look back to the previous vowel.
tajweedIntro-ra.text: Furta rāʾ da sauti mai kauri idan tana da fat’ha ko damma, da siririn sauti idan tana da kasra. Idan rāʾ tana da sukuni, fat’ha, damma ko kasra ta ɗan lokaci kafin ta suna sa sautinta ya yi kauri. Kasra ta asali a kalmar ɗaya yawanci tana siranta sautinta. Harafi mai kauri da ya biyo baya a kalmar ɗaya yana iya sa sautinta ya yi kauri. Idan an tsaya da sukuni, yāʾ mai sukuni kafin rāʾ tana barin sautinta siriri. Idan wani harafi mai sukuni ne ya gabaci rāʾ, duba wasalin da ya zo kafin wannan harafin.

tajweedIntro-sifat-breath.source: A letter’s ṣifāt describe how it sounds at its articulation point. Start by noticing what happens to your breath when the letter is still.
tajweedIntro-sifat-breath.text: Siffofin harafi suna nuna yadda yake sauti a wurin fitowarsa. Fara da lura da yadda numfashinka yake yayin da harafin yake da sukuni.

tajweedIntro-sifat-flow.source: Listen for how long the sound of a still consonant can continue. Breath and sound have separate qualities.
tajweedIntro-sifat-flow.text: Saurari tsawon lokacin da sautin harafi mai sukuni zai iya ci gaba. Numfashi da sauti suna da siffofi dabam.

tajweedIntro-waqf.source: These small signs guide where to pause or keep reading. The marked examples use the Uthmani edition because signs can differ between editions.
tajweedIntro-waqf.text: Waɗannan ƙananan alamomi suna nuna inda za a tsaya ko a ci gaba da karatu. An yi amfani da rubutun Usmani a misalan domin alamomin na iya bambanta bisa bugun mushafi.

tajweedKeepPractising.source: Read the examples aloud or try the drill again.

tajweedNunIntro.source: When a nūn has sukūn ({arabic}), or a word ends in tanwīn, the next letter guides how you read it when you continue.
tajweedNunIntro.text: Idan nūn tana da sukuni ({arabic}), ko kalma ta ƙare da tanwini, harafi na gaba yana nuna yadda za ka karanta idan ka ci gaba.

umrahPrepPhraseReview.text: Jimlolin gwaji don atisayen karatu. Ana jiran bitar sautukan da aka ɗauka.

umrahPrepRitualHint.source: Spoken guidance for all seven steps
umrahPrepRitualHint.text: Jagorar murya ga dukan matakai bakwai

umrahPrepTakeHint.source: Umrah mode runs on your phone. Export this trip as a file and open it there. Everything stays on your devices.
umrahPrepTakeHint.text: Salon Umara yana aiki a wayarka. Fitar da wannan tafiyar a matsayin fayil ka buɗe shi a wayar. Komai yana nan a na’urorinka.

umrahPrepareHint.source: Set it up here, then open awwab on your phone
umrahPrepareHint.text: Shirya a nan, sannan ka buɗe Awwab a wayarka

umrahSaiAutoCount.text: Ƙidayar zanguna bisa wurin da kake (gwaji)

umrahSaiCorrection.text: Saita adadin zangunan da aka gama zuwa {count, number}

umrahSaiCorrectionHint.source: Tap a lap to correct the count

umrahSaiDetected.source: Lap {lap, number} detected at {place} · tap a lap to correct
umrahSaiDetected.text: An gano zango na {lap, number} a {place} · taɓa zango don gyarawa

umrahSaiEnableLocation.source: Turn on location to count automatically
umrahSaiEnableLocation.text: Kunna gano wuri don ƙidayawa kai tsaye

umrahSaiGreenLights.text: Fitilun kore · maza su yi ɗan takun gudu

umrahSaiPendingLocation.source: Waiting for a location fix near the walkway
umrahSaiPendingLocation.text: Ana jiran gano wurinka kusa da hanyar sa’ayi

umrahSetTripHint.source: Set your trip dates and hotel before you go.
umrahSetTripHint.text: Saita ranakun tafiyarka da otal kafin ka tafi.

umrahStep-halq-note-1.source: men shave or trim; women trim a fingertip’s length
umrahStep-halq-note-1.text: maza su yi aski ko su rage gashi, mata su rage tsawon kan yatsa

umrahStep-halq-summary.source: Men shave or trim their hair. Women trim their hair.
umrahStep-halq-summary.text: Maza su yi aski ko su rage gashinsu. Mata su rage gashinsu.

umrahStep-ihram-summary.text: San inda miƙatinka yake kafin ka isa.

umrahStep-sai-note-1.source: Ṣafā → Marwah = 1 lap; finish at Marwah
umrahStep-sai-note-1.text: Daga Safa zuwa Marwa zango ɗaya ne. A ƙare a Marwa.

umrahStep-sai-note-2.source: men jog lightly between the green lights
umrahStep-sai-note-2.text: maza su yi ɗan takun gudu tsakanin fitilun kore

umrahStep-sai-summary.source: Ṣafā to Marwah is one lap. Finish the seventh at Marwah.
umrahStep-sai-summary.text: Tafiya daga Safa zuwa Marwa zango ɗaya ne. Ƙare zango na bakwai a Marwa.

umrahStep-talbiyah-summary.source: Recite the Talbiyah after making your intention.
umrahStep-talbiyah-summary.text: Karanta talbiya bayan ka yi niyya.

umrahStep-tawaf-note-3.source: between Yemeni corner and Black Stone: Quran 2:201
umrahStep-tawaf-note-3.text: tsakanin Kusurwar Yaman da Baƙin Dutse: Alƙur’ani 2:201

umrahStep-tawaf-summary.source: Start at the Black Stone line with the Kaʿbah on your left.
umrahStep-tawaf-summary.text: Fara daga layin Baƙin Dutse, Ka’aba tana gefen hagunka.

umrahStep-two_rakahs-note-1.source: behind Maqām Ibrāhīm if possible; anywhere in the masjid if crowded
umrahStep-two_rakahs-note-1.text: bayan Maƙamin Ibrahim idan zai yiwu, a wani wuri a masallacin idan akwai cunkoso

umrahStep-two_rakahs-summary.source: Behind Maqām Ibrāhīm if you can, elsewhere in the masjid if crowded.
umrahStep-two_rakahs-summary.text: Yi salla bayan Maƙamin Ibrahim idan zai yiwu. Idan akwai cunkoso, yi a wani wuri a masallacin.

umrahStep-zamzam-summary.source: Drink Zamzam before continuing to Saʿy.
umrahStep-zamzam-summary.text: Sha ruwan Zamzam kafin ka ci gaba zuwa sa’ayi.

umrahTripDateError.source: Pick an end date on or after the start date.
umrahTripDateError.text: Zaɓi ranar ƙarshe daidai da ranar farko ko bayanta.

umrahTripImportHint.source: This replaces the saved trip details and duʿā request list on this device.
umrahTripImportHint.text: Wannan zai maye gurbin bayanan tafiya da jerin buƙatun addu’a da aka ajiye a wannan na’ura.

umrahTripSaveError.source: Your trip details could not be saved.
umrahTripSaveError.text: Ba a iya ajiye bayanan tafiyarka ba.

umrahTripSaved.source: Trip plan saved on this device.
umrahTripSaved.text: An ajiye tsarin tafiya a wannan na’ura.

umrahWalkAutoHint.source: Beta · you can always correct a lap
umrahWalkAutoHint.text: Gwaji · kana iya gyara zango a kowane lokaci

umrahWalkByLocationHint.source: The guide advances at supported places
umrahWalkByLocationHint.text: Jagorar tana matsawa idan ka isa wurin da take iya ganewa

umrahWalkIntro.source: With location on, the guide can recognise when you reach the Haram, Ṣafā or Marwah, or a hotel pin you’ve saved. This is optional and your location stays on this device.
umrahWalkIntro.text: Idan ka kunna gano wuri, jagorar tana iya gane lokacin da ka isa Harami, Safa, Marwa ko alamar otal da ka ajiye. Zaɓi ne, kuma bayanin inda kake yana nan a wannan na’ura.

umrahWalkMemory.source: Remind me of my hotel & gate
umrahWalkMemory.text: Tunatar da ni otal da ƙofata

umrahWalkMemoryHint.source: Keep your saved hotel pin and remember mapped gates as you pass
umrahWalkMemoryHint.text: Riƙe alamar otal ɗinka ka tuna ƙofofin da ke kan taswira yayin wucewa

umrahWalkPermissionDenied.source: Location permission is off in this browser. You can count laps by hand.
umrahWalkPermissionDenied.text: An kashe izinin gano wuri a wannan burauzar. Kana iya ƙidaya zanguna da hannu.

umrahWalkPrivacyHint.source: Location is used only while Umrah mode is open. Any saved places stay on this device. Ṭawāf stays tap-to-count because GPS near the Kaʿbah can be unreliable.
umrahWalkPrivacyHint.text: Ana amfani da inda kake ne kawai yayin da salon Umara yake buɗe. Wuraren da ka ajiye suna nan a na’urarka. Ana ƙidayar ɗawafi da taɓawa domin GPS kusa da Ka’aba na iya yin kuskure.

umrahWalkTitle.text: Bari Awwab ya tafi tare da kai

umrahWalkVoiceBlocked.source: Tap Listen to resume voice guidance.
umrahWalkVoiceBlocked.text: Taɓa «Saurari wannan matakin» don ci gaba da jagoran murya.

umrahWalkVoiceHint.source: Read each step aloud after you start a downloaded voice
umrahWalkVoiceHint.text: Bayan ka fara sautin da ka sauke, za a karanta kowane mataki da murya

umrahWalkVoiceStart.source: Play this step to start voice guidance for the rest of your session.
umrahWalkVoiceStart.text: Kunna wannan matakin don fara jagorar murya a sauran tafiyarka a wannan zaman.

umrahWalkVoiceStop.text: Tsayar da jagorar murya ta atomatik

understandSalah.text: Fahimci abin da kake faɗa a {term_salah}

welcomeHeading.source: For those who keep coming back.
welcomeHeading.text: Ga masu komawa, sau da sau.

welcomeMeaning.source: “…He is ever forgiving to those who keep returning.”
welcomeMeaning.text: «…Shi Mai yawan gafara ne ga masu yawan komawa gare Shi.»

welcomeOffline.source: No judgement. No accounts. Works fully offline, and everything stays on your phone.
welcomeOffline.text: Babu hukunci ko asusu. Yana aiki gaba ɗaya ba tare da intanet ba, kuma komai yana nan a wayarka.

whichSound.source: Which sound do you hear as you read?
whichSound.text: Wane sauti kake ji yayin karatu?

withoutHarakat.text: Karanta ba tare da wasalai ba

wordBankNewHint.text: ana ƙara su bisa yawan fitowarsu

wordBankOneRoot.source: one root, a whole family of words
wordBankOneRoot.text: tushe ɗaya, rukunin kalmomi gaba ɗaya

wordBankRootHint.source: each one unlocks a word family
wordBankRootHint.text: kowane tushe yana taimaka maka ka gane dangin kalmominsa

wordBankSortedByFreq.source: sorted by how often each word appears in the Quran
wordBankSortedByFreq.text: an jera kalmomi bisa yawan fitowarsu a Alƙur’ani

wordBankSubtitle.source: 125 core Quran words, their roots, and how they live on in modern Arabic
wordBankSubtitle.text: Muhimman kalmomin Alƙur’ani 125, tushensu da yadda ake amfani da su a Larabcin yau

wordGloss-إذ.text: lokacin da / ku tuna lokacin da

wordGloss-اتخذ.text: ya ɗauka / ya mai da shi

wordGloss-كفرون.text: waɗanda ba su yi imani ba

wordGloss-لما.text: lokacin da / har yanzu bai yi ba

wordGloss-لو.text: da a ce / ina ma da

wordSaveError.source: This word could not be saved.
wordSaveError.text: Ba a iya ajiye wannan kalmar ba.

writeBayt.source: Bayt means “house”. The Quran uses it in Al-Quraysh 106:3. It is also used in modern Arabic.
writeBayt.text: Bayt na nufin «gida». An yi amfani da kalmar a Alƙur’ani a Al-Quraish 106:3. Ana amfani da ita a Larabcin yau ma.

writeBoatCue.source: Right → left, then the dot below
writeBoatCue.text: Daga dama zuwa hagu, sannan ɗigo a ƙasa

writeBoatFamily.source: The “boat” family: one body, different dots
writeBoatFamily.text: Rukunin «jirgin ruwa»: siffa ɗaya, ɗigogi dabam-dabam

writeBoatTip.source: Keep the bowl on the line. Bāʾ has one dot below and Tāʾ has two above.
writeBoatTip.text: Ka riƙe siffar kwanon a kan layi. Bāʾ yana da ɗigo ɗaya a ƙasa, Tāʾ kuma biyu a sama.

writeDots.source: The outline is close. Check the dots.
writeDots.text: Siffar ta kusa dacewa. Duba ɗigogin.

writeFamily.text: Rukunin haruffa na {number, number} cikin {total, number}

writeFollowCue.source: Follow the guide, then add the dots
writeFollowCue.text: Bi jagorar, sannan ka ƙara ɗigogin

writeFollowShape.source: Follow the dotted stroke to the end

writeInputs.source: Works with mouse, trackpad, touch or stylus. Compare overlays the model on your strokes.
writeInputs.text: Yana aiki da linzamin kwamfuta, allon linzami, taɓawa ko alƙalamin allo. «Kwatanta» yana ɗora samfurin a kan rubutunka.

writeNonJoining.source: {name} has an alone form and an end form. It stops before the next letter.
writeNonJoining.text: {name} yana da siffa idan yana shi kaɗai da siffa a ƙarshen kalma. Ba ya haɗuwa da harafi na gaba.

writeRaCurve.source: Curve down and to the left, below the line
writeRaCurve.text: Lanƙwasa zuwa ƙasa da hagu, a ƙarƙashin layi

writeRaStart.source: Start at the dot, just above the line
writeRaStart.text: Fara a ɗigon da ke ɗan sama da layin

writeRaTail.source: Finish with a thin tail in the same stroke
writeRaTail.text: Ƙare da siririn wutsiya a layi ɗaya

writeStartCue.text: Fara a ɗigon da ke da lamba

writeTraceTip.source: Use the overlay to compare your strokes with the model.
writeTraceTip.text: Yi amfani da samfurin da aka ɗora don kwatanta rubutunka.

zakatAbove.text: Ya kai nisabi ko ya wuce

zakatAmountMax.text: Shigar da {max, number} ko ƙasa da haka.

zakatAssets.text: Dukiyar da kake da ita yau

zakatAssetsNeedPrices.source: Enter prices for all metals you’ve included.
zakatAssetsNeedPrices.text: Shigar da farashin duk ƙarafan da ka lissafa.

zakatCalculatorNote.source: A calculator, not a fatwa. Ask a scholar about your situation.
zakatCalculatorNote.text: Wannan kayan lissafi ne. Ka tambayi malami game da halin da kake ciki.

zakatConvertedAmountInvalid.source: Enter a smaller price to change its unit.
zakatConvertedAmountInvalid.text: Shigar da ƙaramin farashi don sauya ma’auninsa.

zakatDebt.text: Bashin da ya kamata a biya yanzu

zakatEnterAmount.source: Enter a number using digits and a decimal separator if needed.
zakatEnterAmount.text: Shigar da adadi da lambobi. Idan ya zama dole, yi amfani da alamar ƙashi.

zakatEstimated.text: Kiyasin zakkar da za a bayar

zakatGoldNote.source: The gold threshold is based on {weight, number} grams. Scholars differ on which threshold to use for cash.
zakatGoldNote.text: Nisabin zinariya yana kan gram {weight, number}. Malamai sun bambanta kan nisabin da za a yi amfani da shi ga kuɗi.

zakatHawlHeader.source: Your zakat date · {hijri} · {days, plural, =0 {today} one {in # day} other {in # days}}
zakatHawlHeader.text: Ranar zakkarka · {hijri} · {days, plural, =0 {yau} one {nan da kwana #} other {nan da kwanaki #}}

zakatJewelleryNote.source: Scholars differ on jewellery you wear. The Hanafi view includes it.
zakatJewelleryNote.text: Malamai sun bambanta kan kayan adon da ake sawa. A ra’ayin Hanafiyya ana haɗa su.

zakatNet.text: Dukiyar da ake cire wa zakka

zakatNextHawl.source: Your zakat date · {hijri} ({gregorian}) · {days, plural, =0 {today} one {in # day} other {in # days}}
zakatNextHawl.text: Ranar zakkarka · {hijri} ({gregorian}) · {days, plural, =0 {yau} one {nan da kwana #} other {nan da kwanaki #}}

zakatNoPayments.text: Har yanzu babu biyan zakka da aka rubuta.

zakatPaymentHistory.text: Biyan baya da sauran nau’o’in kuɗi

zakatPriceNote.source: Enter today’s gold and silver prices in your currency. Prices stay on your device.
zakatPriceNote.text: Shigar da farashin zinariya da azurfa na yau a kuɗinka. Farashin yana nan a na’urarka.

zakatRate.text: {rate} na dukiyar da ake cire wa zakka bayan cire basussuka

zakatRateAmount.text: {rate} na {net} na dukiyar da ake cire wa zakka bayan cire basussuka

zakatReceivables.text: Kuɗin da wasu suke bin ka

zakatRecipient.text: Wanda ya karɓa ko bayanin kula (zaɓi ne)

zakatSaveError.source: Your changes could not be saved. Try again.
zakatSaveError.text: Ba a iya ajiye canje-canjenka ba. Sake gwadawa.

zakatSetHawl.source: Set your Hijri anniversary in settings to get a reminder.
zakatSetHawl.text: Saita ranar cikar shekarar Hijira a Saituna don samun tunatarwa.

zakatShortMonth.source: The reminder falls on the last day of this shorter month.
zakatShortMonth.text: Tunatarwar za ta zo a ranar ƙarshe ta wannan gajeren watan.

zakatSilverNote.source: Silver can give a lower threshold. Many Hanafi scholars recommend using it for cash and other assets.
zakatSilverNote.text: Nisabin azurfa na iya zama ƙasa. Malaman Hanafiyya da yawa suna ba da shawarar amfani da shi ga kuɗi da sauran dukiya.

zakatWornNote.source: Scholars differ on jewellery you wear. The Hanafi view includes it. This is a calculator, not a fatwa.
zakatWornNote.text: Malamai sun bambanta kan kayan adon da ake sawa. A ra’ayin Hanafiyya ana haɗa su. Ana amfani da wannan kayan don lissafi kawai.
